jobs.title: Cyber Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Description**

**Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?**

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

**Your greatest work is ahead!**

Leidos’ ***Defense Uncrewed Systems Integration*** ***and Test*** is seeking a motivated and ambitious **UAS** **Cyber SW Engineer** to join the Software, Simulation, Systems Engineering and Integration Directorate (S3I) Joint Technology Center – Systems Integration Lab (JSIL) Technology and Certification Center. As a **UAS** **Cyber SW Engineer**, you’ll be an integral part of a dynamic engineering team that supports UAS cyber systems. This role bridges the gap between software engineering and cybersecurity. The candidate will be responsible for the security architecture, secure coding, static/dynamic code analysis, and vulnerability remediation for critical application software across the full software development lifecycle. Working directly within an Agile/Scrum team, the candidate will ensure complex systems meet rigorous DoD cybersecurity requirements (such as DISA STIGs/SRGs and RMF standards) while actively contributing to modern continuous integration and automated software delivery pipelines.

**If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading!**

**Leidos Defense Sector** provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here!

**Are you ready to make an impact? Share your resume with us today!**

**Primary Responsibilities**

* **Secure Software Development & Engineering:** Participate in the full lifecycle design, coding, testing, and integration of secure embedded and application software for military systems using C/C++ and Object-Oriented methodologies.
* **Static & Dynamic Code Analysis:** Perform, analyze, and track static and dynamic code analysis scan results (e.g., Parasoft, Coverity, Fortify) to identify vulnerabilities, eliminate security flaws, and guide development remediation efforts.
* **Security Control Implementation & Hardening:** Work with cross-functional software teams to implement and automate technical security controls, including DISA STIGs, SRGs, and industry best practice hardening guidelines across Linux, databases, and application baselines.
* **Security Code & Architecture Reviews:** Evaluate software requirements, system design changes, and proposed merge requests for security impact to determine authorization and risk mitigation.
* **CI/CD & Pipeline Security (DevSecOps):** Integrate automated security testing and compliance checks within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Microsoft Azure DevOps, Git).
* **Vulnerability Scanning & Remediation:** Analyze vulnerability scan outputs (such as ACAS/Nessus) to develop and implement code- or configuration-level remediation plans.
* **RMF & Artifact Support:** Assist in updating Risk Management Framework (RMF) artifacts, including software/firmware inventories, interface specifications, and Ports, Protocols, and Services Management (PPSM) documentation.
* **Cross-Discipline Collaboration:** Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, technical interchange meetings, and hardware/software design reviews alongside Systems, Cyber, Safety, Operations, and Test teams.

**Basic Qualifications**

* The candidate must have a Bachelor’s degree in Software or Computer Engineering or a related STEM field from an accredited institution with four (4) years of applicable experience, or an additional Masters degree in a Cyber Security related field with two (2) years of experience.
* U.S. citizenship, an active DoW Secret Security Clearance and the ability to maintain a Secret Clearance are required.
* Must hold or be willing to acquire a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., **CompTIA Security+ CE**, CySA+, or higher/equivalent).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Strong hands-on programming experience with Rust, C/C++ or other Object-Oriented languages.
* Direct experience running and interpreting **Static Code Analysis** tools (e.g., Fortify, Sonarqube, Parasoft).
* Practical understanding of **DISA STIGs/SRGs** and application security (AppSec) hardening.
* Experience operating within an **Agile/Scrum** software development environment.
* Experience with source control, build systems, and CI/CD tools (e.g., **Git, Visual Studio, etc.**).
* Strong working knowledge of **Linux** and Windows operating environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with customer stakeholders and multi-disciplinary teams.

jobs.title: Model-Based Systems Engineer, Mid-Level
jobs.description:
**Model-Based Systems Engineer, Mid-Level**

**Overview**

SimTech, Inc., recognized as one of the **2026 Best Places for Working Parents**, is seeking a **Model-Based Systems Engineer, Mid-Level** to join our dynamic and diverse team in Huntsville, AL. This is an immediate opening with opportunities for growth and professional development.

SimTech offers a market leading compensation package with excellent benefits, work/life balance, outstanding retirement plan, career advancement and much more.

We are seeking a **Model-Based Systems Engineer (MBSE)** with 4–7 years of experience to support the design, development, and integration of the RF Scene Generator system using model-based methodologies. This role will focus on developing and maintaining system models to improve program execution, reduce risk, and enhance system understanding across the lifecycle.

**Responsibilities**

Develop, implement, and maintain system models using MBSE methodologies (e.g., SysML, UML).

Support system architecture development, requirements decomposition, and traceability within modeling environments.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams including software, hardware, and test engineering to ensure system integration and consistency.

Perform trade studies and analysis to support system design decisions.

Maintain digital engineering artifacts in accordance with program and customer requirements.

Support verification and validation (V&V) activities through model-based approaches.

Assist in configuration management and change control processes for system models.

Provide technical input for program reviews, design reviews, and customer briefings.

Ensure compliance with DoD standards and digital engineering strategies.

Other responsibilities as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications & Education Requirements**

Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent from an accredited institution required.

4–7 years of experience in systems engineering, with demonstrated experience in MBSE.

Hands-on experience with MBSE tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler, MagicDraw, or similar.

Strong understanding of systems engineering lifecycle processes (requirements, design, integration, verification).

Strong understanding of radar systems, functionality, and target phenomenologies.

Experience with SysML and/or UML modeling languages.

Experience supporting DoD or government programs.

Familiarity with digital engineering environments and frameworks.

Experience with tools such as DOORS, JIRA, or other requirements/configuration management tools.

Knowledge of architecture frameworks (e.g., DoDAF, UAF).

INCOSE Certification (e.g., ASEP, CSEP).

Experience with Agile or DevSecOps environments.

U.S. Citizenship with Active TS/Secret Security clearance and ability to maintain required clearance.

**Physical Description**

Employees in these positions will function in a general office/cubicle setting environment, and laboratory/testing setting using standard office equipment and various electronic testing equipment, including a computer, telephone, printers, video equipment, computer software and testing equipment. Will interact in a general office setting environment with various personnel; participate in meetings and contribute to team success; deliver timely results and produce reports; receive and communicate information; may include telework. May function in a specialized laboratory/testing environment using electronic testing equipment, computer software and complex systems. May move and test equipment of various weights. Laboratory environment may require use of protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to safety glasses and protective hearing and footwear. May be expected to work varying shifts and hours to ensure successful operation of activities in the organization due to business demands; travel occasionally for assigned work.

SimTech's mission is to be the most reliable and cost-effective provider of Signature Models, Simulations, Hardware, Software, Cyber solutions, and Test & Evaluation services. Established in 1983 by a team of experienced scientists and engineers, SimTech has a long history of delivering high-technology defense-oriented solutions.

The company has been recognized as a **"Best Place to Work"** in **2020** and **2021,** and as a **"Best Place for Working Parents"** in **2022-2026** by the Huntsville/Madison County Chamber of Commerce.

SimTech offers an industry-leading comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Be a part of over 43+ years of excellence-join our team today!

To learn more about our exceptional team and employee benefits, contact SimTech HR or visit www.simtechinc.com for more information.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
**EOS Defense Systems USA designs and produces highly accurate, cost-effective, modular, and scalable Remote Weapon Systems that give warfighters a decisive edge in counter-UAS and ground-to-ground missions. Trusted across platforms, we're at the forefront of defense innovation.**  
  
At EOS our people are our strength. Here, engineers own their work throughout its life cycle. Working side by side with a small, multi-disciplinary team in a safe, collaborative workplace. The pace is fast, the mission is real, and you'll build your skills and grow your career while advancing technology that matters, from advanced effectors to AI. If you're looking for hands-on engineering in a culture that empowers you to take ownership, work autonomously, and contribute directly to the mission, EOS Defense Systems USA is the place to be. advancing technology that matters, from advanced effectors to AI. If you want hands-on engineering in a mission-ownership culture, EOS Defense Systems USA is the place to be.  
  
**Electrical Engineering Lead (Remote Weapon Systems)**  
  
EOS is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Electrical Engineering Lead to direct a small, dedicated team of electrical engineers across multiple Remote Weapon System (RWS) development programs. The ideal candidate will drive our technical solutions and actively foster a mission-ownership culture within the team. You will be instrumental in providing senior-level technical leadership, mentoring junior talent, managing daily tasking, and maintaining strict accountability for engineering quality and delivery schedules. This is a critical leadership role that directly impacts our program success and team cohesion.  
  
This is an on-site position located at our facility.  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Technical Leadership & Oversight: Serve as the technical authority for the electrical engineering team, guiding the architectural design, development, and integration of complex electronics for RWS's.
* Team Mentorship & Cohesion: Actively mentor and coach younger engineers to accelerate their professional growth; build a highly collaborative, cross-functional team environment.
* Tasking & Resource Management: Manage, prioritize, and assign engineering tasks across multiple concurrent programs to optimize team bandwidth and satisfy project milestones.
* Culture of Ownership & Accountability: Foster a strong culture of ownership where team members take pride in and maintain full accountability for the quality, reliability, and on-time delivery of their designs.
* Schedule & Quality Management: Maintain engineering schedules, conduct rigorous design reviews, and ensure all electrical engineering deliverables meet stringent aerospace/defense quality standards.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with systems, software, and mechanical engineering leads to seamlessly integrate electrical systems into mechanical gimbals, slip rings, and overall weapon platform architectures.

  
**Required Qualifications:**  

* Education: BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a highly related technical discipline.
* Experience: 8+ years of progressively responsible engineering experience, with a proven track record of leading or managing small technical teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Industry Background: Demonstrated experience working within a US Government Contracting / Defense environment.
* Security Clearances: Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret-level U.S. security clearance. Must be a US citizen.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* RWS Hardware Expertise: Direct experience with RWS's hardware, specifically mechanical gimbals, slip rings, and ruggedization for defense environments.
* Advanced Electronics Design: Deep proficiency in schematic capture, multi-layer PCB layout, microcontroller/FPGA hardware integration, and high-voltage pulsed power systems. Additional experience in brushless DC (BLDC) motor drive, high speed video capture and transmission, ten gigabit ethernet, and fiber optic experience.
* Design Tools: Mastery of Altium Designer for simulation, schematic capture, and PCB layout. Other tools such as Cadence and Expedition may suffice.
* Strong Theory Foundations: Comprehensive understanding of advanced electromagnetic, circuit, and manufacturing theories applied to safety-critical hardware.
* Communication Skills: Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills required to brief leadership, interface with clients, and rally an engineering team.

  
**Outstanding Benefits/Perks:**  

* Excellent insurance coverage
* 401(k) match
* Generous PTO
* Tuition Reimbursement
* 9/80 Work Schedule

  
EOS Defense Systems is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identification and sexual orientation) or national origin in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. An Equal Opportunity Employer for disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, other protected veterans, and armed forces service  
medal veterans. An Equal Opportunity Employer of individuals with disabilities. We participate in E-Verify.

jobs.title: Regional Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!  
  
About the Role:  
As the Regional Automation Engineer, you will engage on all aspects of high-level support for the control systems within a region of Amazon sites. This work takes the form of direct field engagement for launch and existing facilities, commissioning, on-call, continuous improvement, change management, project management, training, security, infrastructure and systems administration. You will deliver this through the use of statistics and data analytics, structured problem solving, implementation of global support mechanisms, system performance monitoring tools, identification and dissemination of best practices. In this role, you will also develop and implement standard operating procedures, optimal code/parameter sets, performance metrics, and feedback mechanisms to ensure reliability and operational efficiency of our equipment.  
  
What Do We Offer?  
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

* You will troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, industrial networks (Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, Profinet, ASi), motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* You will apply Subject Matter Expertise (SME) on troubleshooting and dive deeps for engineering issues, supporting a region of onsite automation engineers to investigate the root cause and planning actions to eliminate/mitigate the downtime of critical assets
* You will provide technical guidance and decision making for collaboration projects or initiatives with other Amazon teams, being a key stakeholder in supporting technical and major network support requests
* You will provide escalation support to onsite automation engineers, during and after business hours, troubleshooting locally and remotely, to ensure that all hardware or controls software within the building is repaired on time
* You will travel up to 80% to support sites within an assigned region

Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you'll fit right in here at Robotics Technical Services (RTS).  
  
We are a smart team of doers who work passionately to apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers' experiences in ways we can't even imagine yet. You will be responsible for a technical product portfolio. You will launch new systems, develop preventative maintenance procedures, ensure spare part availability, proactively monitor system performance, provide troubleshooting support, and drive continuous improvement initiatives across Amazon's fulfillment network. Working closely with technical support teams and regional support managers, you will build a cohesive organization responsible for the safety, reliability, and performance of emerging robotics technology. This role requires independent judgment and comfort working with ambiguity in a complex, fast-paced, high-throughput environment where multi-tasking is essential.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Payload Integrations team owns everything that connects to the vehicle beyond the base platform. This includes gimbals and EO/IR sensors, arming and fuzing devices, weapons payloads, radios, and other mission hardware. We build the software and interfaces that enable these payloads to reliably run on the vehicle. Nearly every customer program needs a new or modified payload, which makes this team a critical contributor to nearly everything we ship. Our work goes from the lab bench to hardware-in-the-loop testing to live flight, and it has to work in a variety of demanding operational environments.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Payload Integrations team. You will design, build, and maintain the software that brings new sensors, communications systems, and mission payloads onto our autonomous vehicles. You will work closely with hardware, electrical, autonomy, and systems engineering teams, as well as outside payload vendors, to turn new hardware into dependable, well-tested components of the vehicle. If you are self-motivated, hold yourself to high standards, enjoy working where software meets hardware, and do well in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment, this role is for you.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Design and implement software integrations for gimbals, EO/IR sensors, radios, arming and fuzing devices, and other mission payloads on autonomous vehicles.
* Define and maintain clean, reusable interfaces between payloads and the vehicle software stack, to enable new payloads without changes to autonomy code.
* Work through vendor interface control documents (ICDs), implement device drivers and protocol handlers, and lead hardware bring-up in the lab.
* Build simulation, emulation, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test infrastructure to evaluate payload behavior before flight.
* Support integration events, ground tests, and flight tests, and root-cause issues across software, firmware, and hardware boundaries.
* Partner with program teams to scope, estimate, and deliver payload integrations for customer projects on tight timelines.
* Contribute to the safety-critical software behind arming and weapons-related payloads, with a high bar for rigor, review, and testing.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* Strong experience with Rust and/or C++, plus working proficiency in Python.
* Hands-on experience integrating hardware over common interfaces and protocols (e.g., UART/RS-422, CAN, Ethernet/UDP, SPI/I2C).
* Experience reading datasheets and ICDs and turning them into robust software implementations.
* Comfort debugging at the hardware/software boundary using lab equipment and bus/packet analysis.
* Experience developing on Linux-based systems.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, including working with external vendors and cross-functional engineering teams.
* US Persons: Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.

* Experience integrating gimbals, cameras, EO/IR sensors, or tactical radios and datalinks.
* Familiarity with safety-critical or arming/fuzing systems and related development practices.
* Experience with UAS, missiles, or other aerospace/defense platforms.
* Experience building HIL/SITL test environments or hardware emulators.
* Familiarity with middleware and serialization frameworks (e.g., Protobuf, gRPC, DDS, MAVLink).
* Experience with embedded Linux, real-time systems, or resource-constrained environments.
* Background supporting field integration and flight test campaigns.
* Active U.S. security clearance, or the ability to obtain one.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Realtime Pipeline
jobs.description:
**About Bridge Neurotech**
--------------------------

Bridge Neurotech is building a non-invasive functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) platform with AI-based neural decoding for brain-computer interface applications. We are a seed-stage neurotechnology company developing technology that has the potential to transform how we interact with the human brain.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a Software Engineer - Realtime Pipeline to own the realtime system that runs from raw RF data off the probe all the way to decoded outputs from our neural decoding model — beamforming, imaging preprocessing, and ML inference, all in one tightly coupled latency budget. The inference latency budget is tightly coupled to the imaging pipeline latency budget: they share GPU, share memory, share the data stream. This role owns the entire realtime path and is accountable for it as one system.

Given the neural decoding model, you turn it into a production realtime decoder, sitting on top of the imaging pipeline you have also built. We build from open primitives like the Mach beamformer (https://github.com/Forest-Neurotech/mach), and you provide the technical leadership and strategy to mature the system — designing, developing, testing, deploying, and enhancing it into a scalable software solution — including what to extend, what to replace, and what to push upstream.

You will work closely with our ML/AI Lead on the model serving boundary, our Embedded Systems Engineer on the data handoff from the probe, our Imaging Scientist on the imaging pipeline itself, and our Applications Engineer on the decoded output handoff downstream.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own the end-to-end realtime path: raw RF data ingestion, beamforming, processing (e.g., clutter filtering), ML preprocessing, model inference, and decoded output.
* Build the ML inference engine: model loading from artifacts, GPU memory residency, batching, TensorRT/ONNX or hand-built CUDA inference, and kernel-level integration with the upstream imaging compute.
* Integrate, extend, and, where appropriate, contribute to GPU beamforming.
* Hit and hold realtime throughput and latency targets at multi-Gbit/s ingest with deterministic tail latency suitable for closed-loop decoding.
* Define and own the model serving contract with the ML/AI Lead and the path for model updates without service interruption.
* Build the streaming and storage layer that serves raw and processed data to both offline training and realtime inference.
* Collaborate with other team members to define the upstream interface to the device acquisition layer and the downstream interface to the BCI applications layer.
* Build observability into every stage and develop benchmarks and regression tests that lock in both pipeline performance and inference correctness as the system evolves.

**Who You Are**
---------------

**Required**

* BS/MS/PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field, with 8+ years building production realtime or HPC systems.
* Expert-level CUDA and modern C++; experience writing or extensively modifying GPU kernels for signal processing or imaging workloads.
* Demonstrated experience building production ML inference systems: taking trained PyTorch (or equivalent) models to deployment on GPUs under hard latency budgets. Hands-on with TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, Triton, or hand-built CUDA inference engines.
* Demonstrated experience building realtime data pipelines at multi-Gbit/s rates with tight latency budgets.
* Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and the signal processing stack relevant to imaging or RF: beamforming concepts, FFTs, IQ demodulation, SVD-based filtering, autocorrelation.
* Proficiency in Python and the PyTorch ecosystem sufficient to collaborate with the ML team, identify what needs to change for production, and have informed conversations about model architecture trade-offs that affect latency.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with functional imaging or other high-data-rate imaging modalities.
* Experience integrating ML inference with upstream realtime compute, including shared GPU memory layouts and minimizing host–device round-trips.
* Experience with high-bandwidth I/O: GPUDirect Storage, RDMA, kernel-bypass networking, NVMe arrays.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* The opportunity to shape a role and a team from the earliest stages.
* Direct collaboration with leading clinicians and neuroscientists at top-tier academic institutions.
* Excellent medical benefits and a 401(k) with 6% match.

Bridge Neurotech is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Embedded Firmware Engineer**
==============================

**Efference** - Robust Robotic Perception

**Location**: North Beach, San Francisco, CA

**Employment** **Type**: Full Time

**Location** **Type**: On-site

**Department**: Engineering

**Company Overview**
--------------------

Efference builds robust, high-performance robotic perceptual systems that make robots easier to develop and faster to deploy. Our technology integrates proprietary optical designs, advanced sensor fusion, depth estimation, image sensor processing, and tightly optimized hardware-software stacks to enable reliable perception across general and specialized robotic systems.

We are currently deploying the first generation of vision systems with state-of-the-art hardware and software while actively prototyping generations two and three of our core perceptual system.

Efference was founded by Gianluca Bencomo, a PhD student at Princeton University whose research spans visual neuroscience, Bayesian filtering for fast and robust sensor fusion, neural network inductive biases, and robotics perception. The company is backed by Y Combinator and Anti Fund.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

As a Embedded Firmware Engineer at Efference, you will lead the design, implementation, and integration of low-level software that powers our next-generation robotic perception systems. You will work at the boundary between custom hardware and advanced perception software, enabling reliable, high-performance sensing across cameras, IMUs, and other robotic sensors.

This role requires deep expertise in embedded Linux, real-time systems, and hardware bring-up, as well as the ability to collaborate closely with PCB designers, perception researchers, and full-stack engineers. Your work will directly influence the performance, reliability, and deployability of Efference’s custom camera and sensing platforms across multiple product generations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead firmware architecture and development for ARM-based SoCs and MCUs
* Read, modify, and maintain device trees, BSPs, and board support packages
* Review and approve schematics and PCB layouts, with a focus on signal integrity, power distribution, and manufacturability
* Develop and maintain embedded Linux systems using Buildroot and Yocto
* Implement and optimize RTOS-based firmware for real-time sensing and control
* Write and maintain kernel drivers and low-level device drivers for sensors and peripherals
* Integrate and optimize MIPI-CSI camera pipelines, including basic camera bring-up and tuning
* Implement and debug WiFi and Bluetooth connectivity on embedded platforms
* Work with a wide range of communication interfaces, including CAN, USB, RS-485, UART, I²C, SPI, GMSL, etc.
* Integrate and calibrate sensors such as IMUs, cameras, LiDAR, and other robotic sensing modalities
* Perform hands-on hardware debugging using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other lab tools
* Collaborate with perception, robotics, and full-stack teams to support teleoperation, data collection, and on-device inference
* Contribute to product roadmaps, technical documentation, and platform evolution across multiple hardware generations

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a related field
* 3+ years of professional experience in embedded systems or firmware engineering
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ for embedded and systems programming
* Experience working with embedded Linux on ARM-based SoCs
* Deep understanding of hardware–software co-design, including power, clock, and memory subsystems
* Proven experience bringing up custom hardware from early prototypes through production
* Familiarity with common MCUs and peripheral architectures
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills across hardware and software layers

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with Rust for embedded or systems programming
* Background in robotics, perception, or sensor fusion
* Familiarity with robotic control systems and real-time constraints
* Personal interest or hands-on experience in robot learning or autonomous systems
* Experience supporting high-throughput image or sensor data pipelines

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a seed-stage, venture-backed startup
* Opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotic perception and applied research
* Close collaboration with world-class researchers and engineers
* High-impact role with significant technical ownership and growth opportunities

jobs.title: Lead Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**About SleepRes**

SleepRes is developing next-generation sleep apnea therapy technologies that improve patient outcomes. We are a small, fast-moving R&D team focused on building high-quality medical devices that make a real-world impact.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Lead Electrical Engineer to lead the electrical and electronic architecture of current and next-generation positive airway pressure (PAP) therapy systems.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you will own the design, integration, verification, and production implementation of device electronics, including power architecture, PCBAs, sensors, blower and heater interfaces, display and user-interface hardware, communications hardware, electrical safety, EMC, and production-test interfaces.

You will work closely with systems, firmware, mechanical, software, V&V, NPI, quality, regulatory, overseas suppliers, and contract manufacturers to deliver reliable, compliant, and manufacturable electronics from concept through commercialization.

**Level**

This role may be filled at the Staff or Principal level based on experience, technical scope, and demonstrated leadership.

* Staff: Typically 8+ years of relevant product-development experience. Serves as the primary technical owner for the electrical discipline, leads architecture and cross-functional technical decisions, mentors engineers, and remains deeply hands-on in design, testing, and commercialization.

* Principal: Typically 10–12+ years of relevant experience with demonstrated platform-level technical leadership. Acts as a company-level authority for electrical architecture, establishes engineering standards, resolves the most complex multidisciplinary problems, mentors senior engineers, and influences multiple product generations.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead electrical architecture, design, development, and verification for SleepRes PAP products

* Own main control PCBAs, power distribution and conversion, sensor interfaces, blower and heater electronics, display/UI hardware, communications hardware, and electrical protection circuitry

* Translate system requirements into electrical specifications, interfaces, component selections, design margins, and production-ready solutions

* Lead schematic, PCB layout, component-selection, tolerance, derating, grounding, shielding, and signal-integrity reviews

* Own electrical-safety and EMC engineering, including early pre-compliance testing, troubleshooting, and support of formal certification testing

* Lead the hardware side of cellular, BLE, Wi-Fi, antenna, SIM/eSIM, and RF integration and support FCC, PTCRB, carrier, and related certification activities

* Support verification, reliability testing, and hands-on root-cause investigation using appropriate electrical laboratory equipment

* Work with NPI, PCBA suppliers, and contract manufacturers on DFM, testability, ICT/functional test, calibration, programming, end-of-line test, yield, and design transfer

* Partner with Operations and Strategic Sourcing on component lifecycle, alternate-source qualification, supplier changes, value engineering, and cost reduction

* Support design controls and risk management, including requirements, specifications, DFMEA, verification documentation, engineering reports, and design changes

**What We're Looking For**

* BS in Electrical Engineering or related engineering discipline (MS preferred)

* 8+ years of relevant electrical product-development experience; Principal-level candidates will typically bring 10–12+ years and demonstrated platform-level technical leadership

* Strong experience with analog and digital circuit design, embedded microcontroller systems, power electronics, sensor interfaces, PCB design, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and EMC

* Strong hands-on laboratory and troubleshooting skills using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, power analyzers, electronic loads, and related equipment

* Experience with component selection, tolerance analysis, derating, lifecycle management, and alternate-component qualification

* Demonstrated experience taking complex electromechanical products from concept through commercial production

* Experience working directly with PCB assemblers, contract manufacturers, and component suppliers

* Strong systems thinking, communication, and ability to lead technical decisions in a fast-paced cross-functional environment

**Nice to Have**

* Experience developing CPAP, ventilator, respiratory, anesthesia, patient-monitoring, or other medical devices

* Medical-device development experience under ISO 13485 and FDA design controls/QMSR

* Familiarity with IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2, IEC 60601-1-11, and applicable IEC/ISO 80601 requirements

* Experience with pressure/flow sensors, blowers or motors, resistive heaters, thermistors, TFT/LCD displays, cellular modems, BLE, or Wi-Fi

* Experience with FCC, PTCRB, cellular-carrier, or other wireless-device certification

* Experience with production-test systems, high-volume Asian manufacturing partners, and electrical failure analysis

* Experience leading electrical engineers or serving as the electrical technical lead for a multidisciplinary product program

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer II
jobs.description:
**The Role:**

Helogen is seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer II** in Los Angeles, CA to lead the design and development of the electrical power systems for Keystar, our orbital power plant project. You'll be joining a resourceful and scrappy team that includes a Systems Engineer, Senior Systems Architect, Software Lead, and Lead Vehicle Design Engineer. We ideate and prototype rapidly, wear multiple hats, absorb new skills, and apply our past experience in creative ways. We value individual ownership within an overall framework of accountability and trust.

As a Senior Electrical Engineer II, you'll be the technical owner of the electronics that generate, condition, store, and distribute power across the Keystar spacecraft. You’ll guide electrical hardware development from the initial smallsat demonstrator through the high-voltage power management and distribution (PMAD) architecture required as the campaign scales. In this role, you’ll be hands-on with the hardware while setting the power-electronics architecture and design standards the rest of the electrical team inherits.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the design of the electrical power subsystem (EPS/PCDU) for the Keystar spacecraft, including power generation, conditioning, distribution, and battery systems
* Establish the high-voltage power management and distribution (PMAD) architecture as the program scales; set technical parameters, evaluate tradeoffs, manage margins and risks, and develop high-voltage PCDU/PMAD and EMI filtering solutions
* Design high-voltage systems for reliable operation in vacuum, accounting for electrical breakdown, corona discharge, insulation, and component derating
* Develop, test, and document prototypes, engineering models, and flight hardware; create schematics, PCB layouts, and technical documentation to support fabrication and manufacturing
* Build and test hardware using rapid prototyping techniques, including breadboarding, PCB assembly, bench testing, and debugging
* Establish board bring-up processes and design standards as the electrical team grows
* Lead design-for-manufacturing reviews and work with manufacturing teams to transition designs into production
* Guide electrical hardware through Assembly, Integration, & Test (AI&T), and environmental qualification
* Maintain design documentation and identify hardware for reuse or requalification as the program evolves

**What We're Looking For:**

**Requirements:**

* 6+ years of experience in electrical design and circuit analysis for spacecraft
* Direct experience with spacecraft power systems, such as solar arrays, power control and distribution units (PCDUs), battery management systems, or high-voltage power distribution
* Strong experience in schematic capture, PCB layout, and circuit design
* In-depth understanding of power electronics, including DC-DC conversion, power distribution, battery management, and switching efficiency
* Experience designing or qualifying high-voltage power electronics, including an understanding of corona discharge, electrical breakdown in vacuum, insulation, and component derating
* Strong understanding of analog and digital electronics, component selection, and electrical compatibility
* Fluency with Design for Manufacturing (DFM) principles and electronics fabrication and assembly
* Hands-on experience with rapid prototyping and hardware testing, including breadboarding, PCB assembly, bench testing, and debugging
* Proficiency with electronic design and analysis tools such as Altium, KiCad, SPICE, or equivalent
* Familiarity with space-environment design considerations, including radiation, thermal-vacuum testing, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMI/EMC)
* Knowledgeable about relevant engineering standards for spacecraft power systems, high-voltage design, environmental testing, and EMI/EMC
* Experience taking hardware through formal design reviews and qualification under configuration control
* Flexible, resourceful, and decisive, with the ability to evaluate tradeoffs, manage risk, and make sound engineering decisions
* Hands-on approach to hardware development, with experience building, testing, and iterating physical systems

**Nice to Have:**

* Knowledge of embedded systems, firmware, sensor interfaces, precision measurement, or instrumentation
* Experience through AI&T and formal design reviews; experience mentoring junior engineers
* Startup or early-stage engineering experience

**Compensation:**

The salary range for this position is **$130,000-$150,000** annually. Qualified candidates must be based in Los Angeles, California or willing to relocate there.

**Benefits:**

* Build alongside a founding team of visionaries and investors from NASA, Blue Origin, SpaceX, and the ISS
* Unlimited PTO
* Health, dental, vision and life insurance
* 401(k) program
* Membership to OneMedical
* Be part of creating something new that will change the world

**Export Control Requirements**

Due to the nature of the work performed, applicants must be a U.S. Person as defined by U.S.\* export control regulations or otherwise eligible to access export-controlled information and technology.  

* U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum in the U.S.)

Compensation Range: $130K - $150K

jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team:**

The Avionics team is responsible for the full lifecycle of Terran R's nervous system, designing, building, testing, installing, and operating the hardware that connects and controls every major electrical system on the vehicle and ground. The team leverages close partnership between avionics design, manufacturing, and test to enable rapid iteration and feedback loops. Engineers are deeply embedded into other functions within Relativity, working closely with propulsion, GNC, fluids, and stage engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and operation. Now is a unique time to join: you'll get to help shape Terran R's fundamental avionics architecture and be given a high degree of ownership on components that will fly.

**About the Role:**

As a Digital Hardware Engineer on the Avionics team, you will design, test, and analyze custom high-speed electronics on the Terran R launch vehicle. You will oversee hardware development through the entire product lifecycle from concept to flight maturity to include initial design, board bring-up, design verification, qualification, initial flight production, integration, and vehicle operations. You will work with cross-functional partner teams across the company to help the team make the best possible decisions for the overall vehicle. A strong candidate for the role will have a deep technical background in electronics design and sound project management skills to ensure the hardware project is both reliable and on-schedule to support Terran R's launch!

**About You:**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Operating Systems
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet.

**About the Role**
==================

As a Senior Operating Systems Engineer on Apex's Flight Software team, you will design, develop, and own the software that brings our spacecraft to life. You will tackle the hardest problems in autonomous systems and build robust software that enables reliable spacecraft operation 24/7, across every phase of a mission. You will work closely with our mission operations, GNC, and hardware teams to architect new systems, prototype ideas, and turn them into mission-critical software that ultimately flies.

Experience in the space industry is not necessary to thrive at Apex. Instead, we are looking for motivated engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, balance technical rigor with practicality, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

The Flight Software team is composed of three interconnected teams: high-level application software, operating system software, and embedded software. There is significant collaboration and crossover across these teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop the low level software that configures and drives the processor peripherals and communication interfaces on our avionics.
* Develop, configure, and maintain embedded Linux platforms and bootloader frameworks, including Yocto, Buildroot, WolfBoot, and U-Boot.
* Design, implement, and validate firmware update mechanisms, including bootloader integration, secure firmware deployment, and recovery procedures.
* Design and implement security enhancements across complex software architectures to improve system integrity, resilience, and secure operation.

**Requirements**
----------------

* U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data.
* Bachelor's degree in CS, EE or equivalent, or equivalent professional experience.
* 8+ years writing code for operating systems, ideally Yocto or embedded Linux on spacecraft, robotics, automotive, or other hardware what that interacts with the physical world
* Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or Rust

**Preferred requirements**
--------------------------

* Experience developing, testing, deploying, and troubleshooting mission-critical satellite software from prototyping through flight operations.
* Experience with embedded Linux platforms and bootloader frameworks (e.g., Yocto, Buildroot, WolfBoot, U-Boot).
* Experience bringing up new avionics and flight hardware from initial power-on through functional verification.
* Experience with hardware/software integration, schematic analysis, and hardware debugging using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.

jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

**What we are looking for**

We’re searching for a **Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure** to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Behavior Analysis builds the systems that make that call: the evals that compare model versions, the embedding search that makes every driving scenario findable, and the introspection tools that show why a model did what it did. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes.

**In this role you will**

* Build and scale evaluation pipelines that compare model versions on large driving datasets: offline evals, slice-based metrics, regression detection, and model-vs-model reports.
* Own embedding and vector-search pipelines over driving data, versioned per model, so engineers can search, cluster and compare how any model represents the world. This is where you’d start: owning embedding generation and search end to end.
* Build model introspection infrastructure (attention, attribution, ablations) that turns “why did the model do that?” from a research project into a query.
* Help define how frontier LLMs, VLMs and agents change ML analysis here: triaging, labeling, clustering and summarizing driving scenarios and eval results. We already have a prototype using LLMs for data curation, and you’d help decide where it goes next.
* Work side by side with the ML engineers training these models to decide what to measure, then make those measurements trustworthy, observable and cheap enough to run on every candidate model.
* Build the web app and CLI that engineers and AI agents use to find datasets, training runs, evals and their costs, designed with agents as first-class users.

**Required qualifications**

* Typically 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, data or ML infrastructure.
* Strong Python, and proficiency with SQL.
* Designed and operated large-scale batch or data pipelines on cloud infrastructure, including backfills, retries and cost management.
* Built systems that measure or evaluate something: metrics, experimentation, evaluation or analytics platforms.
* Experience with distributed compute and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS Batch or similar).

**Desirable qualifications**

* ML evaluation infrastructure: eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression detection, A/B model comparison.
* Embeddings and vector search, or model introspection and interpretability tooling.
* Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation.
* Autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large-scale sensor data.
* Observability for data systems (metrics, alerting, SLOs), and everyday use of AI coding agents.
* Coming from backend or data engineering and want to learn ML evaluation? Apply anyway: we’ll teach you the ML side.

This role will lead the local setup and deployment of new, fully automated production lines for New Product Introductions (NPI), coordinating equipment installation, integration, commissioning, process validation, and production ramp-up in collaboration with Quanta's HQ automation team in Taiwan and local engineering teams.

jobs.description:
**About Mytra:**

We’re creating an entirely new way to solve the most ubiquitous problem in industry - moving and storing material. We’re applying robotics and distributed software to create a new class of product for this $1T market. We’re focused on the supply chain industry first. The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy.

**About the role**
------------------

As a **Staff Network Systems Engineer** at Mytra, you will be the technical owner and DRI for the network subsystem that ships as part of our robotic warehouse automation product. The network connects our robots, on-premises compute infrastructure, operator interfaces, and supporting systems, and its performance is fundamental to the operation of the overall Mytra system.

This is a product engineering role rather than a traditional corporate IT networking role. You will define what good looks like for networking at Mytra and own the subsystem from requirements and architecture through hardware selection, physical design, configuration, deployment, validation, and ongoing evolution. You will work across software, robotics, electrical, mechanical, systems, deployment, and operations teams to translate system requirements into a network architecture that performs predictably in complex industrial environments.

This is a hands-on design and implementation role. You should be equally comfortable designing a network topology, evaluating switches and wireless access points, determining AP placement, partnering on the design of a network cabinet, configuring equipment, establishing performance requirements and validation methodologies, and debugging difficult problems on a live robotic system.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

* Serve as the technical DRI for Mytra's product network, defining and evolving the architecture supporting our robots, on-premises compute, operator interfaces, and other system components.
* Own wired and wireless network design, including topology, switching, routing, addressing, segmentation, redundancy, QoS, wireless coverage, channel planning, roaming behavior, interference management, and capacity.
* Translate robotics and application requirements such as latency, jitter, packet loss, throughput, availability, roaming performance, and fault tolerance into concrete network requirements, architectures, and acceptance criteria.
* Own the selection, evaluation, qualification, and lifecycle of networking hardware, including switches, routers, firewalls, wireless access points, antennas, cabling, optics, and related components.
* Own wireless architecture and AP placement for environments containing continuously moving robots, designing for predictable connectivity as robots move throughout large industrial structures and transition between access points.
* Partner with Electrical and Mechanical Engineering on the physical design of the networking subsystem, including network cabinets, power, thermal management, cabling, serviceability, installation, and maintainability.
* Define standard network configurations, deployment practices, and automation so a validated network architecture can be reliably reproduced across customer installations.
* Develop network qualification, performance, and acceptance testing covering wireless coverage, roaming, latency, packet loss, throughput, redundancy, capacity, and performance under representative robot fleet loads.
* Establish network observability, telemetry, diagnostics, and troubleshooting capabilities that allow Engineering and Operations teams to understand network health and quickly identify failures or degradation.
* Lead investigation of complex system-level issues spanning robots, wireless connectivity, network infrastructure, on-premises compute, and application behavior.
* Own the technical roadmap for the network subsystem as Mytra systems grow in physical scale, robot count, traffic volume, and deployment complexity.
* Establish the standards, documentation, commissioning procedures, troubleshooting tools, and engineering practices that allow other teams to deploy, operate, and support the network effectively.

**Ideal Candidates:**
---------------------

* Have deep professional experience designing and deploying production network systems and the technical depth to independently own a networking subsystem from architecture through deployment and validation.
* Have strong practical knowledge of Ethernet and IP networking, including switching, routing, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, QoS, redundancy, network segmentation, and network security.
* Have strong practical knowledge of Wi-Fi and RF fundamentals, including 802.11 behavior, channel planning, interference, roaming, antenna characteristics, coverage, capacity, and spectrum analysis.
* Have experience designing wireless networks for **mobile clients where reliable roaming and handoff between access points is critical to system operation**.
* Have experience designing networks for challenging physical or RF environments. Experience with robotics, AMRs/AGVs, autonomous vehicles, industrial automation, manufacturing, logistics, ports, mining, industrial IoT, or similarly complex wireless systems is particularly relevant.
* Understand network performance beyond basic connectivity and can reason quantitatively about latency, jitter, packet loss, throughput, availability, roaming behavior, congestion, and failure modes.
* Have experience selecting, configuring, evaluating, and qualifying commercial networking hardware based on system requirements rather than simply deploying a predetermined vendor solution.
* Have strong hands-on troubleshooting skills using packet capture, spectrum analysis, network telemetry, logging, and other diagnostic tools to investigate difficult network and wireless problems.

------------

We are hiring **software engineers** to build the systems around our robots: the data and infrastructure that our models are trained on, the tools our researchers and operators use every day, and the product our partners will eventually depend on. We are a small team, so everyone works broadly.

* Design, build, and operate production software that our research and operations work depends on.

* Work directly with ML researchers, robotics engineers, and robot operators, who all sit in the same room as you.
* Debug across boundaries, following a problem through services, storage, network, and hardware until it is actually understood.
* Build the logging, monitoring, and diagnostics needed to know whether a system is healthy.

* The ability to work from a described problem rather than a written specification.
* Experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or comparable tools, including reviewing and validating generated code.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer, Workload Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a senior systems software engineer to help engineering teams run demanding build, simulation, and validation workloads efficiently and reliably. Our Workload Systems Engineering team connects customer workflows with the infrastructure that performs them. We develop self-service mechanisms and clear diagnostics, investigate performance and reliability across system boundaries, and deliver measured infrastructure improvements with the teams that own the underlying components.

  

Your responsibilities include enabling application configuration, remote execution, workers, hosts, GPU and CPU resources, storage, data paths, and on-target systems. The position requires direct system evaluation: diagnosing causes of slow or failing workloads, trying alternatives in representative scenarios, applying improvements with others, and verifying customer advantages.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Build shared self-service and validation mechanisms that let engineering teams configure and use supported infrastructure workflows with less manual assistance.
* Give customers and on-call teams useful diagnostic views across application, submission, remote-execution, and host or target layers so they can identify where failures and slowdowns originate.
* Set performance and reliability benchmarks for representative workloads. Apply profiling, metrics, traces, and controlled experiments to pinpoint the changes that make a difference.
* Evaluate and improve compute and GPU selection, scheduling and placement, concurrency, worker and runner configuration, resource sharing, caching, and input/output paths.
* Make retry causes, recovery outcomes, and wasted execution capacity visible. Work with component owners to eliminate recurring failures and unnecessary re-execution.
* Implement and validate infrastructure-level changes with application, build and CI, remote-execution, and infrastructure teams. Measure the effect on turnaround, successful efficiency, stability, usable capacity, and cost.
Turn successful investigations into supported workflows, diagnostics, documentation, and clear customer handoffs.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* Over 8 years of solid software engineering experience working with production compute infrastructure, distributed systems, large-scale build and test systems, or comparable systems software.
* Hands-on experience debugging complex performance or reliability issues across software and hardware boundaries using logs, metrics, traces, profiling, and experiments.
* Proficiency in a systems programming or automation language and experience delivering tested changes into production infrastructure.
* In-depth experience with Linux and proficiency in one or more of these fields: GPU systems and drivers, scheduling and resource management, remote execution or CI infrastructure, storage and data paths, or host and container infrastructure.
* Ability to work across teams with different component ownership, turn ambiguous symptoms into a clear technical plan, and explain results to engineering customers.
A degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience with GPU sharing and isolation, CUDA execution behavior, MIG or MPS or equivalent experience, GPU driver diagnostics, or high-performance computing workloads.
* Experience with workload placement, CPU and GPU concurrency, NUMA, cloud-instance benchmarking, or cost and performance tradeoffs.
* Familiarity with Bazel, remote execution, build front ends, simulation or replay workloads, and hardware-in-the-loop validation.
* Experience improving file-system, caching, networking, or high-throughput data paths under concurrent workloads.
A record of building customer self-service or observability tools and using incident and retry data to drive verified reliability improvements.  

  

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Power Systems Engineer, Grid Interconnection
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**
==================

Heron Power is a startup company building cutting-edge power electronics for the 21st-century grid. We aim to debottleneck the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware solutions, accelerating the electrification of everything.

Our first focus goal is to build better converters (inverters & rectifiers) to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads to the grid. Heron Power’s leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products over the past decade.

We understand that no one individual knows everything. We will all learn *a lot* together and from each other. We strive to build a collaborative, enriching environment conducive to personal, technical, and career growth. You can expect to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, driven by first principles engineering, solving difficult problems.

**Job Overview**
================

You will own the grid interconnection of Heron's grid-forming inverters and solid-state transformers (SST) across utility-scale PV, BESS, and large-load projects, carrying each from model development through interconnection studies, utility and ISO approval, and field commissioning. That means building and validating the models grid operators rely on, demonstrating compliance with grid codes and regulation requirements, and closing the loop between simulation, hardware test, and field performance. You will be Heron's technical voice with utilities, ISOs and RTOs, developers' interconnection teams, and customers, working hand in hand with the Controls and Systems Integration teams: they own the inverter platform, you own getting it connected to the grid. That credibility also makes you central to supporting the sales, designing Heron's power systems solutions and giving customers confidence in how our hardware performs on the grid.

**How You Will Contribute**
===========================

* *Own Heron's inverter and plant models across RMS and EMT platforms (PSS/E, PSLF, PowerFactory, TSAT, and PSCAD), including user-defined models, WECC generic models and their grid-forming variants, and EMT models built from Heron's production controls.*
* *Benchmark models against one another and against controller hardware-in-the-loop, and produce the model validation reports, parameter sheets, and user guides that utilities and ISOs require.*
* *Support interconnection studies for PV, BESS, hybrid, and large-load projects.*
* *Guide developers through the interconnection process, including inverter technology changes on queued projects: prepare model submittals, respond to study comments and deficiency letters, and work through material modification and restudy reviews with transmission providers.*
* *Carry projects through energization: define plant controller (PPC) settings and coordination, write and run commissioning and model validation test plans, analyze field data and disturbance recordings, and support post-energization performance reviews.*

**What You Will Bring**
=======================

We have a short list of must-have requirements. We prioritize a strong grip on first principles, hands-on skills, and a sense of initiative.

**Must-Have Requirements**
--------------------------

* *5+ years of power systems engineering focused on inverter-based resource (IBR) interconnection at an inverter OEM, developer, utility, ISO/RTO, or consulting firm.*
* *A track record of taking IBR projects from model development through interconnection approval and into commissioning, and owning the outcome at each step.*
* *Hands-on proficiency in PSCAD and at least two of PSS/E, PSLF, PowerFactory, and TSAT, including building, tuning, and debugging user-defined models.*
* *Working knowledge of IEEE 2800, NERC PRC and MOD standards, and FERC and ISO/RTO interconnection processes.*
* *Strong grasp of inverter control fundamentals: grid-following and grid-forming control, current limiting, PLL dynamics, and weak-grid and small-signal stability. You can explain why a model behaves the way it does, not just that it passes.*

**Nice-to-Haves**
-----------------

* *Experience with grid-forming inverter models and requirements, such as virtual synchronous machine (VSM) or droop-based controls.*
* *Real-code EMT model development, such as wrapping C or Fortran controller code as a PSCAD DLL using the IEEE/CIGRE DLL interface.*
* *Experience with utility-scale BESS or PV plants, including PPC tuning and grid-code compliance testing.*

If you are passionate about the energy transition and enjoy working at the frontier of power electronics and grid integration, we would love to hear from you. Join us in accelerating the electrification of everything at Heron Power.

Heron Power provides competitive compensation (salary and equity) and benefits. The salary for this role ranges from $160,000 to $200,000 per year

At **CesiumAstro**, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are seeking a **Staff Power Electronics Engineer**to join our growing *spacecraft payload development**team*. In this position, you will contribute across the entire development lifecycle of next-generation power electronics hardware for satellites and space power systems payloads—from leading the definition of power system architectures and trade studies to detailed circuit design, simulation, printed circuit board (PCB) layout, verification and integration testing, production transition, and manufacturing support.

### **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define electrical power system architecture, and derive power subsystem requirements

* Design DC-DC power converters, motor drives, inverters, power management and control circuits from concept to production release

* Perform detailed design for low to high complexity analog and power electronics circuits ranging from single DC-DC power converters to multi-output power supply modules

* Develop design verification test plans, requirement compliance matrices, system integration and qualification test plans, and production acceptance test plans for power converters and power supply designs

* Lead board bring-up and design verification testing of power electronics circuits and modules

* Lead system integration, qualification campaigns, and release of analog and power electronics designs into production

* Mentor younger engineers and foster knowledge sharing

* Lead a small team of power electronics engineers to drive project execution

* Perform research and monitor power electronics industry trends to drive innovation and generate intellectual property in this area

### **REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor of Science (BS) degree or higher in Electrical Engineering (or related) from an accredited university.

* Minimum of 9 years of experience designing analog and power electronics

* Experience working with electrical power systems and subsystems, including developing power architecture and power requirements, performing trade studies for size, weight, power, and cost optimization (SWAP-C), selecting power converter topologies, and defining power management and control blocks

* Experience with modeling and control of DC-DC converters and power stage design of different isolated and non-isolated DC-DC power converters (e.g. discrete linear regulators, Buck, Boost, Buck-boost, Flyback, Forward, Half-bridge, Full bridge, and Resonant converters)

* Experience designing custom signal and power magnetics, and power filters for low noise and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC)

* Experience developing design verification test plans, requirement compliance matrices, system integration and qualification test plans, and production acceptance test plans

* Experience performing worst-case circuit analysis (WCA), stress analysis, failure modes and effects analysis (FMEA), and reliability analysis for power supplies

* Experience with electronics schematic capture and printed circuit board (PCB) layout tools such as Altium, OrCAD, Allegro or Xpedition

* Experience with analysis and simulation tools such as SPICE, LTSPICE, SIMetrix/SIMPLIS, PLECS, Simulink, MATLAB, MathCAD, ANSYS Q3D and SiWave, or HyperLynx

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* Master of Science or PhD in Electrical Engineering with research focus in power electronics

* Experience designing high-reliability analog and power electronics for automotive, space or defense applications

* Knowledge of space radiation environments and radiation effects in electronics

* Experience in power electronics applications utilizing GaN or SiC wide bandgap power semiconductor devices

* Experience running board-level power integrity simulation using tools such as Ansys SiWave, or HyperLynx
