jobs.title: Senior Space Mission Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Varda**
---------------

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

**About This Role**
-------------------

The **Senior Space Mission Software Engineer** is responsible for Varda's critical ground segment software, and the platform it runs on which enables spacecraft operations. We operate at the intersection of telemetry and commanding, data acquisition and distribution, mission control interfaces, simulation and test automation, with reliable deployment across lab, test range, and mission operations environments. You'll work hands-on with flight software, avionics, RF/ground systems, and mission ops.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Own Ground Segment Services:** Develop and maintain high-reliability services for telemetry ingestion, scaling, distribution, and commanding. Ensure deterministic behavior for real-time operations and post-flight analysis.
* **Mission Control Interfaces:** Deliver operator-grade UIs and dashboards that optimize "ops time" and reduce cognitive load across integration, test, and on-orbit operations phases.
* **Simulation and Test Automation:** Build tools to run flight-software simulations, device emulators, and scenario-based automated tests - enabling fast, safe iteration for avionics, GNC, and operations teams.
* **Build the Mission Platform***:* Design, implement, and productionize software for mission and ground software teams. Standardize CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, service templates, infrastructure-as-code, simulation and hardware-in-the-loop frameworks, test harnesses, and observability - all delivered as self-service tooling.
* **Deployments Across Environments:** Create robust deployment patterns for lab benches, test stands, and mission networks. Implement safe rollout/rollback strategies and air-gapped or limited-connectivity deployment approaches.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.
* 5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.
* Expertise with development in Python, along with a strong understanding of the language concepts.
* Have strong systems fundamentals: concurrency, networking, performance, reliability.
* Experience building real-time data acquisition, scaling, and distribution services - low-latency messaging, time-series and relational stores.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD, dependency/build systems, and infrastructure-as-code.
* End-to-end observability experience: logging, metrics, tracing.
* Docker/Kubernetes; release management, phased rollouts, and operational readiness for controlled networks.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------

* Proficiency in C++, Ansible, and/or NiceGUI.
* Experience with DAQ and closed-loop control (lab/test control environments).
* Prior work on CI/testing/simulation/data tools integrated with flight software teams.
* Experience with requirements, test, and certification artifacts from safety-critical or certified workflows.
* Knowledge of ground systems standards; security in mission networks.
* Experience building mission-grade UIs with structured command workflows, alarming, and situational awareness.

**Pay Range**
-------------

* Salary range: Senior Software: $169,067 - $216,031/ per year.
* This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.
* Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.
* You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire "U.S. persons" who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox's data platform powers analytics, ML, and product decisions for a platform serving 200M+ daily active users. As a **Principal Software Engineer** in the **Data Platform Orchestration** team, you will be the technical leader for the system that schedules and runs the company's data workloads. Our team owns Apache Airflow and the Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure underneath it, running 8,000+ DAGs every day, most of them Spark jobs. You will set the long-term architecture for how Roblox orchestrates data at scale, and you will be hands-on in making it faster, more reliable, and easier for hundreds of engineers to use.

**You Will:**

* **Define the Orchestration Strategy:** Own the multi-year architecture for Airflow and the surrounding platform, including scheduler and executor design, multi-tenancy, upgrades and migrations, and where the platform should evolve next.
* **Scale and Harden Airflow:** Find and remove scaling limits across the scheduler, metadata database, executors, and DAG parsing. Make sure thousands of daily DAGs run with predictable latency and strong SLAs.
* **Own Orchestration on Kubernetes:** Lead the design and operation of our EKS clusters for orchestration and Spark workloads, including autoscaling, resource isolation, cost efficiency, and deployment automation.
* **Build Platform Tooling for Internal Engineers:** Design the APIs, custom operators and providers, libraries, and self-service tooling that let data teams build, deploy, and monitor pipelines safely.
* **Drive Observability and Reliability:** Establish SLOs, alerting, and diagnostics for pipelines and platform components. Lead incident reviews and fix the root causes in code, not just in runbooks.
* **Lead Across Teams:** Work with data platform, governance, data science, and product engineering teams to align roadmaps, guide technical decisions, and build consensus on complex initiatives.
* **Raise the Engineering Bar:** Set standards for code quality, design, and operational readiness. Mentor staff, senior, and mid-level engineers.

**You Have:**

* B.S. equivalent in CS or sufficient experience.
* [10+] years of experience designing, building, and operating production-grade, large-scale distributed systems.
* **Workflow Orchestration Depth:** Deep, hands-on experience designing, running, and scaling a production data-related workflow orchestrator or job scheduler (thousands of workflows or DAGs a day). Apache Airflow is ideal, but experience with an equivalent system (Dagster, Prefect, Temporal, or a large in-house scheduler) is also welcome. You understand scheduler and executor design, metadata store performance, task isolation, retries and idempotency, and safe upgrades and migrations.
* **Kubernetes Expertise:** Proven experience managing and scaling production Kubernetes clusters on AWS (EKS), including Helm, autoscaling (Karpenter or Cluster Autoscaler), and GitOps-style deployment.
* **Software Engineering Foundations:** Strong proficiency in Python, plus Go or Java, with a record of writing clean, well-tested platform and tooling code. You are a software engineer who builds and improves systems, not someone who mainly handles tickets and operations.
* **Data Workload Familiarity:** Working knowledge of how Spark jobs run on Kubernetes (Spark on K8s, spark-operator, or EMR on EKS) and how orchestration interacts with them.
* **Platform Mindset:** Experience building platforms used by other engineers, with strong instincts for APIs, observability, reliability, and developer experience.
* **Cross-Organizational Technical Leadership:** A track record of influencing direction across a large engineering organization and driving multi-quarter projects from concept to production.
* **Extreme Ownership:** You define the problem when requirements are unclear, unblock dependencies, and see complex work through to stable production.
* Bonus Points:
  + Contributions to Apache Airflow or related open-source projects (Airflow providers, Helm chart, spark-operator, Karpenter, Argo CD).
  + Experience with other orchestration systems (Dagster, Temporal, Argo Workflows, Flyte) and the judgment to know when each fits.
  + Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code, Prometheus/OpenTelemetry, and cost optimization or chargeback for shared platforms.
  + Experience operating infrastructure at consumer-internet scale.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox’s data platform processes petabytes of data daily, powering analytics, ML, and product decisions. The Data Platform Compute team owns the compute layer underneath it: the Kubernetes (EKS) clusters where all of Roblox’s Spark workloads run, and the software that lets engineers, analysts, and ML practitioners submit and run that work reliably and cost-effectively.

As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you will build and operate the systems that sit between our users and the cluster. These include the Spark job submission service, our internal Spark libraries, interactive notebook compute, and cluster lifecycle automation. You’ll have real ownership, you’ll work on problems where the design is not yet settled, and you’ll help decide which technologies Roblox adopts next.

**You Will:**

* **Build and own core compute platform services:** Design, build, and operate the software behind Spark job submission, including APIs, scheduling integration, and the libraries users depend on.
* **Launch interactive Spark at scale:** Deliver Spark Connect to support notebook workflows, including provisioning and managing the EKS compute that backs them, with sensible isolation, resource limits, and cost controls.
* **Run a safe, automated cluster fleet:** Build fleet management automation for EKS, such as blue-green rollouts that validate new AMIs and Kubernetes versions before they reach production workloads, with minimal disruption to running jobs.
* **Make jobs run better without user effort:** Develop our auto-tuner, which analyzes Spark history and event logs to recommend or apply job configuration changes that improve performance and reduce cost.
* **Own batch scheduling on Kubernetes:** Operate and upgrade our YuniKorn-based scheduling, including queue design, quotas, fairness across tenants, and version upgrades.
* **Shape what we adopt next:** Evaluate emerging technology such as native Spark acceleration (e.g., Apache Comet). Run rigorous benchmarks on real Roblox workloads and make a clear recommendation backed by data.
* **Be an owner of reliability and cost:** Define SLOs and metrics, build observability, and drive down toil, incidents, and compute spend across a multi-tenant platform.
* **Partner across the company:** Work with data engineering, ML, analytics, and infrastructure teams to understand their needs, communicate changes, and migrate users to better paths.

**You Have:**

* 5+ years of experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems or infrastructure platforms.
* **Spark on Kubernetes:** Hands-on experience running Apache Spark on Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, or self-managed) as a platform, including executor and driver behavior, resource tuning, and troubleshooting failed or slow jobs. We are looking for platform builders, not just Spark users.
* **Kubernetes depth:** Strong experience operating production Kubernetes clusters at scale, such as upgrades, node lifecycle, autoscaling, and operators or controllers.
* **Engineering foundations:** Strong proficiency in at least one of **Go, Java, Scala, or Clojure**, with a track record of writing clean, well-tested, maintainable backend code. Python is a plus, since much of our tuning and analysis tooling uses it.
* **Cloud fluency:** Experience with AWS (EKS, EC2, IAM, S3) or GCP equivalents, and infrastructure-as-code.
* **Operational ownership:** Experience taking a system from design through production operation, including on-call, incident response, and observability.
* **Technical leadership:** Ability to influence design decisions across teams, mentor engineers, and drive alignment on cross-cutting changes.
* B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
* Bonus Points:
  + Experience with YuniKorn, Volcano, Kueue, or other batch schedulers on Kubernetes.
  + Experience with Spark Connect, Livy, Kyuubi, or other interactive and gateway layers for Spark.
  + Experience with the Spark Operator, Karpenter, Helm, Terraform, or Argo.
  + Experience building tooling that uses Spark event logs or metrics for tuning, cost attribution, or anomaly detection.
  + Experience maintaining internal Spark builds or driving Spark version upgrades.
  + Familiarity with native execution engines (Comet, Gluten, Velox) or JVM performance tuning.
  + Experience migrating workloads from YARN/Hadoop to Kubernetes.
  + Contributions to open-source projects in the data or Kubernetes ecosystem.
  + Experience operating at consumer-internet scale (100M+ users).

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Google Home Infrastructure team builds the platform that powers hundreds of millions of smart home devices. We connect speakers, displays, cameras, thermostats, locks, sensors, and home entertainment systems with intelligence and cloud services.

Our mission is to create a resilient, low-latency distributed backbone that turns disconnected smart devices into a unified, proactive, and assistive ecosystem. As homes transform from reactive voice commands to autonomous, multi-agent AI experiences that assist families in their daily lives, our infrastructure delivers the mission-critical distributed storage, real-time event streaming, high-throughput authorization, device lifecycle management, and agentic control planes that make it all possible at global scale.

The Google Home team focuses on hardware, software and services offerings for the home, ranging from thermostats to smart displays. The Home team researches, designs, and develops new technologies and hardware to make users’ homes more helpful. Our mission is the helpful home: to create a home that cares for the people inside it and the world around it.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

jobs.title: Robotics Field Hardware Engineer, Robotics Technical Services
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Application deadline: Oct 24, 2026  
  
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you'll fit right in here at Robotics Technical Services (RTS).  
  
We are a smart team of doers who work passionately to apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers' experiences in ways we can't even imagine yet. The RTS Field Support team provides critical support to internal fulfillment and transportation network customers relying on advanced robotics technology.
  
  
You will be responsible for a technical product portfolio. In this role, you serve as the vital link between on-site technicians and RTS engineering teams, ensuring maximum performance of advanced robotics systems. You will launch new systems, develop preventative maintenance procedures, ensure spare part availability, proactively monitor system performance, provide troubleshooting support, and drive continuous improvement initiatives across Amazon's fulfillment network. You will establish standard operating procedures, performance metrics, and feedback mechanisms that enable the RTS team to scale effectively. Working closely with technical support teams and regional support managers, you will build a cohesive organization responsible for the safety, reliability, and performance of emerging robotics technology. This role requires independent judgment and comfort working with ambiguity in a complex, fast-paced, high-throughput environment where multi-tasking is essential.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Provide on-site support for new product implementations, upgrades, hardware audits, and troubleshooting for advanced robotics systems
* Partner with site-level reliability (RME) and controls teams to maximize advanced robotics system performance
* Identify, analyze, and resolve mechanical and system issues across the RTS product suite
* Design and implement electro-mechanical tools, fixtures, and diagnostic solutions to minimize troubleshooting and machine downtime
* Develop and implement proactive monitoring tools to measure safety, reliability, and performance of advanced robotics systems
* Create escalation processes, standard operating procedures, and preventative maintenance protocols for the RTS product suite
* Design and lead training sessions and develop training content for on-site RME teams
* Develop and implement spare parts management systems and processes
* Produce performance reports and provide "voice of the customer" feedback to development and support teams
* Up to 75% travel expected

  
A day in the life  
Your day begins by reviewing system performance reports for your regional portfolio. Perhaps the metrics dashboard revealed unusual performance at a facility or spare parts dropped below threshold at a site. You analyze metrics to identify trends and risks, developing de-risking actions for leadership's weekly business review. You troubleshoot with RME technicians via video, walking them through diagnostic procedures. On-site, you conduct hardware audits for new deployments, gathering customer feedback. Afternoons include designing tools, optimizing processes, and coordinating with regional managers on scaling strategies. Throughout, you're the critical link between field technicians and engineering teams. Every member on the team leverages AI to drive efficiency and most build with it; you will be provided ample learning resources and challenges to demonstrate your skillset.
  
  
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:  
  
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage  
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options  
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)  
4. 401(k) Plan  
  
If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!  
  
About the team  
RTS Field Hardware Support Engineers (FHSE) ensure that our customers—site Reliability and Maintenance Engineers—are equipped to independently maintain Amazon Robotics technologies. Our team achieves this by identifying deficiencies, communicating risk, and proposing mitigation strategies. Our hands-on approach to testing, troubleshooting, and investigating puts us in the shoes of operators and technicians in the field. We work backwards from these insights to satisfy engineering requirements, partnering with safety, hardware, software, and cross-functional support teams.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 4+ years of systems engineering experience
* Experience maintaining the resilience and reliability of services by troubleshooting deployment failures, creating infrastructure as code, creating resources (alarms, metrics, IAM role credentials), infrastructure provisioning and patching hosts
* Experience in automation or monitoring frameworks, deployment or development

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience performing testing and tuning
* Experience designing and developing scripts to automate operational burdens and reviewing scripting changes to ensure they meet the standards for maintainability, scalability and security
* Experience designing, implementing, and executing systems and processes to ensure the reliability and performance of product

jobs.title: Process Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
AtmosZero is building the next generation of industrial steam infrastructure. Our flagship product, Boiler 2.0, is a modular industrial steam heat pump designed to help manufacturers reduce operational risk, improve flexibility, and modernize steam generation over time. Rather than forcing facilities to choose between reliability and sustainability, AtmosZero enables a practical path toward future-ready steam systems that integrate with existing operations and scale with customer needs.

AtmosZero · Loveland, Colorado (onsite) · Full-time

**Reports to:** Sr. Director, New Product Development

**Why this role exists**

Boiler 2.0 is a modular industrial heat pump that produces steam from electricity and air. AtmosZero is running Pilot, Prototype, and 1 MW development activities in parallel, and each system must be tested, understood, protected, and improved. This role adds hands-on process-engineering capacity across those systems so existing technical leaders can focus more heavily on product segmentation and cost-down engineering.

**Level and scope**

* **Engineer III.** Independently own significant process or thermal-system workstreams, coordinate technical interfaces, and deliver results from requirements and analysis through testing, troubleshooting, and implementation.
* **Senior Engineer I.** Lead complex system work through ambiguity, own major technical workstreams end to end, mentor teammates, and influence cross-functional decisions.

**What you will do**

* **Test, troubleshoot, and improve**
* + Define test objectives, plans, procedures, acceptance criteria, instrumentation, and data-acquisition requirements across Pilot, Prototype, and 1 MW systems.
  + Support test execution, analyze operating data, identify root causes, and define engineering changes that close performance and reliability gaps.
  + Prepare systems for commissioning and resolve process, instrumentation, and controls issues during startup and operation.
* **Define how the system operates**
* + Develop operating sequences, operating envelopes, alarms, permissives, interlocks, fault protection, and recovery behavior with controls engineers.
  + Translate process intent into clear controls requirements, instrumentation specifications, setpoints, and validation tests.
* **Standardize execution**
* + Maintain and improve P&IDs, process requirements, test procedures, operating methods, and decision records.
  + Convert test and operating learning into repeatable system designs, validated limits, and controlled engineering changes.

**What success looks like in your first year**

* In the first 90 days, build a working model of the Pilot, Prototype, and 1 MW systems and independently support a test campaign or commissioning-readiness workstream.
* By six months, own recurring test and troubleshooting work, close process or controls issues, and release the resulting procedures or engineering changes.
* By twelve months, establish a standardized process, operating method, or protection strategy that is validated in hardware and reused across systems.

**What we need from you**

* Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, or a related discipline, with relevant experience at the level at which you are hired.
* Strong command of thermodynamics, heat transfer, fluid mechanics, and process-control fundamentals.
* Demonstrated experience testing and troubleshooting thermal-fluid or process systems in hardware.
* Experience with instrumentation, data acquisition, test planning, data analysis, P&IDs, operating procedures, and engineering-change definition.
* Ability to develop operating sequences, alarms, permissives, interlocks, and fault-protection requirements with controls engineers.
* Comfort working directly with technicians and engineers in a startup environment where systems and documentation evolve together.

**What would help**

*We do not expect anyone to have all of this.*

* Advanced degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience with industrial heat pumps, refrigeration, steam systems, process skids, HVAC equipment, or comparable thermal-fluid hardware.
* Experience with PLC-controlled equipment, controls commissioning, functional testing, or cause-and-effect development.
* Fluency with MATLAB, Python, EES, Aspen Plus/HYSYS, GT-SUITE, or comparable analysis tools.
* Experience taking prototype hardware through commissioning, qualification, production release, or field troubleshooting.

**Compensation and benefits**

**Base salary range:**

* **Engineer III** [$110,000 - $165,000]
* **Senior Engineer I** [$125,000-$180,000]

**Equity:** Stock option grant

**Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement plan; paid time off and holidays; parental leave.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
AtmosZero is building the next generation of industrial steam infrastructure. Our flagship product, Boiler 2.0, is a modular industrial steam heat pump designed to help manufacturers reduce operational risk, improve flexibility, and modernize steam generation over time. Rather than forcing facilities to choose between reliability and sustainability, AtmosZero enables a practical path toward future-ready steam systems that integrate with existing operations and scale with customer needs.

AtmosZero · Loveland, Colorado (onsite) · Full-time · Senior Engineer I

**Reports to:** VP, Engineering

**Why this role exists**

Industrial steam runs manufacturing across food, pharmaceuticals, specialty chemicals, and other essential industries, yet most steam is still produced by combustion-based boilers. AtmosZero is replacing that legacy equipment with an electrified platform designed for practical deployment in existing boiler rooms.

Boiler 2.0 is a modular industrial heat-pump system that produces steam using electricity. We are moving the platform from development hardware into repeatable customer delivery, with a 1 MW customer system now driving controls implementation, integration, testing, and commissioning readiness.

The controls challenge spans process sequences, compressor and drive interfaces, distributed instrumentation, protection logic, HMI and SCADA, industrial networking, data infrastructure, and live-system troubleshooting. This role adds the hands-on capacity to complete the 1 MW system and turn first-unit learning into a reusable controls platform for future systems.

**Level and scope**

*We are hiring an experienced engineer who can own major portions of an industrial controls system from requirements through commissioning. The role is intentionally hardware-close: you will move between design documentation, PLC code, HMI and SCADA configuration, panels, field devices, test equipment, and operating data.*

* **Controls Engineer (5+ years).** You own controls implementation and issue resolution for assigned systems and subsystems, while helping establish the architecture, software standards, diagnostics, and commissioning methods needed for repeatable product delivery.

*If your experience does not follow a conventional path but you have commissioned complex industrial equipment and can demonstrate strong controls judgment, apply anyway.*

**What you will do**

* **Deliver the 1 MW controls system**
* + Complete PLC programming, sequence implementation, controls integration, and system-level testing for the 1 MW Boiler 2.0 platform.
* + Develop and verify startup, normal operation, shutdown, maintenance, fault, trip, and recovery behavior, including interlocks, permissives, alarms, timeouts, and protective responses.

* + Own controls issue resolution during panel checkout, I/O checkout, build, factory acceptance testing, commissioning, and early operation.
* **Build the controls architecture and software platform**
* + Develop modular, state-based control software using consistent equipment modules, control modules, interfaces, naming, and version-control practices.
* + Configure Siemens PLC and distributed I/O hardware, industrial networks, drives, IO-Link devices, instrumentation, and third-party equipment interfaces.

* + Create reusable code libraries, simulation and test utilities, diagnostic tools, and deployment practices that reduce commissioning effort and replication risk.
* **Develop HMI, SCADA, data, and remote-support capabilities**
* + Build and maintain operator interfaces for commissioning, local operation, troubleshooting, and service, with clear alarm and abnormal-condition presentation.
* + Integrate local and centralized data collection, historian functions, trends, event logging, dashboards, and remote monitoring while maintaining appropriate separation between customer and internal networks.

* + Turn operating and commissioning feedback into improved diagnostics, alarm rationalization, service workflows, and product reliability.
* **Integrate across disciplines**

jobs.title: Thermal Systems Engineer, Product Development
jobs.description:
AtmosZero is building the next generation of industrial steam infrastructure. Our flagship product, Boiler 2.0, is a modular industrial steam heat pump designed to help manufacturers reduce operational risk, improve flexibility, and modernize steam generation over time. Rather than forcing facilities to choose between reliability and sustainability, AtmosZero enables a practical path toward future-ready steam systems that integrate with existing operations and scale with customer needs.

AtmosZero · Loveland, Colorado (onsite) · Full-time · Engineer III / Senior Engineer I

**Reports to:** Senior Director of New Product Development

**Why this role exists**

Boiler 2.0 must become materially lower cost without losing the performance, reliability, controllability, or operating range customers require. This role provides thermal-system and steam-system depth to cost-down concepts, packaging studies, component requirements, and supplier decisions, and turns external analyses into validated production configurations.

**Level and scope**

*We are hiring into this role at whichever of three levels best matches the scope, independence, and judgment demonstrated through the interview process. Apply once and we will place you.*

* **Engineer III.** Independently own significant process or thermal-system workstreams, coordinate technical interfaces, and deliver results from requirements and analysis through testing, troubleshooting, and implementation.
* **Senior Engineer I.** Lead complex system work through ambiguity, own major technical workstreams end to end, mentor teammates, and influence cross-functional decisions.

*If you are between levels or arrived at this expertise through an unusual route, apply anyway.*

**What you will do**

* **Define lower-cost thermal systems**
* + Evaluate thermal-system configurations, packaging concepts, and performance-cost tradeoffs.
  + Define process conditions and requirements for heat exchangers, compressors, valves, pumps, piping, and supporting components.
  + Develop validated lower-cost configurations while protecting performance, reliability, controllability, and operating range.
* **Own heat-exchanger and component decisions**
* + Lead heat-exchanger selection, sizing, qualification, and supplier engagement.
  + Use analysis, test data, and engineering judgment to compare component choices and define validation requirements.
  + Connect system assumptions and component decisions to product requirements, BOM cost, and target cost.
* **Direct external technical work**
* + Coordinate external component-design and thermal-system consultants.
  + Define consultant scope, supply technical inputs, review assumptions and models, and drive useful deliverables to closure.
  + Translate consultant outputs into controlled requirements, design decisions, supplier packages, and test plans.

**What success looks like in your first year**

* In the first 90 days, understand the current thermal architecture and cost-down workstreams and take ownership of a component or configuration study.
* By six months, complete a supplier-backed thermal design or cost-down recommendation with clear requirements, assumptions, risks, and validation needs.
* By twelve months, validate a lower-cost thermal-system or heat-exchanger configuration and move it into a production-intent design.

**What we need from you**

* Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, or a related discipline, with relevant experience at the level at which you are hired.
* Strong command of thermodynamics, heat transfer, fluid mechanics, refrigeration cycles, and steam systems.
* Demonstrated experience designing, analyzing, testing, or troubleshooting industrial thermal-fluid hardware.
* Experience defining component operating conditions, specifications, selection criteria, and qualification plans.
* Experience evaluating system configurations and performance-cost tradeoffs with models, test data, and supplier inputs.
* Ability to direct external technical work and critically review assumptions, calculations, models, and deliverables.

**What would help**

*We do not expect anyone to have all of this.*

* Advanced degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, or a related discipline.
* Detailed heat-exchanger selection, sizing, and qualification experience using HTRI or comparable methods.
* Experience with industrial heat pumps, refrigeration, steam systems, thermal-cycle design, ORC systems, or comparable industrial thermal equipment.
* Experience with component suppliers, design consultants, qualification testing, and production release.
* Fluency with EES, Aspen Plus/HYSYS, MATLAB, Python, GT-SUITE, HTRI, or comparable analysis tools.
* Experience with design-to-cost, value engineering, packaging optimization, or commercialization of thermal equipment.

**Compensation and benefits**

**Base salary range:**

* Engineer III [$110,000 - $165,000]
* Senior Engineer I [$125,000 - $180,000]

*Where an offer lands within a range depends on experience, demonstrated capability, and interview performance.*

**Equity:** Stock option grant

**Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement plan and any match; paid time off and holidays; parental leave.

**Job Grade(s): 08**  
**Job Profile(s): Engineer profiles**

**Introduction of the job**
---------------------------

ASML is seeking a Mechatronics Design Engineer to join the Wilton, CT development location as we break new ground in the emerging field of photolithography. As a Mechatronics Engineer, you will specify, design, develop, realize, integrate, and test modules and tools in a multi-disciplined team, collaborating closely with cross-functional partners and suppliers. You will deliver within system specifications, cost targets, and project schedules, ensuring timely realization of solutions that contribute to competitive, achievable, and serviceable products. The mechatronics engineer provides discipline specific expertise throughout the entire product life cycle. This Includes concept feasibility, new product introduction, existing product sustainment and customer facing problem resolution. The position requires highly motivated, extremely organized, and self-driven individuals.

The mechatronics engineer will work on mechatronics, precision handling of delicate parts, product and system integration and software functionality, all specific to ASML products. The main focus will be mechatronics and control systems on advanced modules in lithography tools. Candidate should have direct experience in the design and test of mechatronic systems and control systems.

As job grade increases, the role expands from executing well-defined engineering work to leading technical scope, realizing complex modules, driving roadmap direction, and steering teams across multiple complex designs to ensure system-level integration and delivery.

This position may require access to controlled technology, as defined in the Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). As a condition of employment, qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require the Company to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

**About SMT, Corp.**  
SMT Corp. is recognized as the industry leader in **counterfeit electronics detection and supply chain assurance**, providing mission-critical components and verification services for high-reliability applications.

**Date posted:** October 19th, 2026

**Pay:** $80,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Job description:

**Electrical Engineer:**

SMT Corp is looking to hire an Electrical Engineer for our state-of-the-art Electrical Test Lab. The Electrical Test Lab is a part of the SMT Corp counterfeit mitigation testing process which is used to authenticate and screen electronic components. SMT Corp’s customer base is primarily composed of defense, aerospace, and high-reliability companies which require extensive testing to purchase electronic components from independent distributors.

Due to the lack of traceability, SMT Corp utilizes industry standard testing methods such as AS6171 or AS6081 to authenticate the material. As a part of that process, the Electrical Test Lab performs electrical testing to validate that the components meet the original component manufacturer’s specifications and quality requirements. As an electrical engineer at SMT Corp, the following items are part of the job responsibilities:

* Interpret customer testing flowdowns and MIL drawings, understand electrical component datasheets, and provide electrical testing quotes to SMT Corp sales people.
* Design PCB test fixtures for a wide variety of electrical components from passives to RF to complex active devices like FPGAs and CPUs.
* Write software to control and automate test equipment to perform electrical testing of components.
* Analyze and review electrical testing results to generate a report summarizing the data, test methods, and all relevant testing information.
* Technical support for Management, Quality Control, Sales, and Component authentication groups.
* Communicate with customers (technical and non-technical) regarding electrical testing requirements/problems and related information.

At a minimum, engineers are required to have the following:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, or related field.

SMT Corp would prefer that candidates have the following:

* Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, or related field.
* Experience with designing and laying out PCB test fixtures for electronic components.
* Experience with National Instruments LabView software to control and automate electronic component testing.
* Experience with complex digital device such as FPGAs, Microprocessors, and Microcontrollers.
* Experience with Advantest test equipment and software.

Company Overview:

About SMT Corp. Based in Sandy Hook, CT and founded in 1998, SMT Corp. is the industry leader for sourcing and authentication of DMSMS, obsolete and hard-to-find electronics components for Aerospace, Defense and critical infrastructure. SMT Corp. is an accredited and recognized expert with full on-site authentication and electrical testing services to mitigate the risk of counterfeit, cloned, altered or substandard products from entering the critical systems supply chain. With more than a half-billion components in stock representing over 1,200 major component manufacturers, SMT Corp. maintains one of the largest “ready to ship” electronic component inventories in the world. SMT Corp’s primary focus is Aerospace & Defense, and other high reliability industries, that require the highest in component quality, traceability and inspection documentation for mission critical applications. The SMT Corp. mission is to provide the highest quality products and value-added services directly to government, OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) and CM (Contract Manufacturer) providers as well as both franchised and non-franchised distributors.

Come join a growing company with a commitment to provide our customers the highest quality products and services, competitive pricing, and fastest response time in the industry.

Industry leader in strategic DMS sourcing, counterfeit mitigation and component authentication testing

jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

**Build hardware that matters-right here in Tampa Bay.**

Custom Manufacturing & Engineering (CME) is seeking an **Electrical Engineer (Analog) or Electrical Engineer II** to design, develop, test, and support electronic hardware used in aerospace, defense, space, industrial, and energy applications.

**We're open to two levels of experience.** This opportunity may be filled as an **Electrical Engineer I** for an early-career engineer ready to develop strong hands-on design skills, or as an **Electrical Engineer II** for an engineer who can bring additional experience and take greater ownership of circuit design, troubleshooting, and technical execution.

Either way, this is a hands-on engineering role.

At CME, you won't be limited to one small piece of a large program. You'll have opportunities to **design circuits, simulate ideas, prototype hardware, work at the bench, troubleshoot problems, collaborate with manufacturing, and see designs progress toward finished products.**

If you want to build your aerospace and defense engineering career in the **Tampa Bay area** while staying close to the hardware, we'd like to hear from you.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

Depending on your experience and level, you will:

* Design and develop **analog and mixed-signal circuits** for power, sensing, signal conditioning, control, and mission-critical systems
* Develop and evaluate circuits involving components such as **op amps, filters, power supplies, converters, sensors, and control circuitry**
* Perform schematic capture and support PCB design and development
* Use **SPICE, LTspice, OrCAD, or similar engineering tools** to simulate, analyze, validate, and refine designs
* Build, prototype, test, and troubleshoot electronic hardware in the lab
* Use oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, function generators, and other test equipment to characterize circuit performance
* Analyze test results, identify root causes, and implement design improvements
* Select electronic components based on electrical requirements, performance, availability, reliability, and application needs
* Work with suppliers and technical vendors to identify components and engineering solutions
* Collaborate with mechanical, software, manufacturing, quality, and test personnel throughout the product lifecycle
* Develop schematics, specifications, test procedures, technical reports, and other engineering documentation
* Support designs from **concept and prototype through verification, manufacturing, and production**
* Participate in design reviews and communicate technical findings, risks, and recommendations
* Support additional engineering activities as part of CME's collaborative, hands-on engineering team

**What You Bring**
------------------

### **Electrical Engineer I**

This level is designed for a **recent graduate or early-career electrical engineer** who has a strong technical foundation and wants to develop practical engineering experience.

You should bring:

* Bachelor's degree in **Electrical Engineering**
* **0–2 years** of relevant electrical engineering experience
* GPA of **3.0 or higher preferred**
* Academic, internship, co-op, research, military technical, senior design, or project experience involving analog electronics
* Foundational knowledge of **analog circuit design**, including areas such as op amps, filters, power supplies, sensing, and signal conditioning
* Familiarity with schematic capture and circuit simulation tools such as **OrCAD, SPICE, LTspice, or similar**
* Hands-on experience with common electronics laboratory equipment
* Ability to read and interpret schematics, datasheets, drawings, and technical documentation
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Ability and willingness to learn from experienced engineers while progressively taking ownership of engineering assignments
* Good written and verbal communication skills

**For EE I candidates, we value demonstrated curiosity and hands-on ability as much as years of experience.** Internships, senior projects, robotics, electronics projects, research, military experience, maker projects, and other practical engineering work can all demonstrate your potential.

### **Electrical Engineer II**

This level is intended for an engineer who has developed a solid foundation in electrical engineering and is ready to take **greater independent ownership of designs and technical problems**.

You should bring:

* Bachelor's degree in **Electrical Engineering**
* Typically **2–5+ years of relevant electrical engineering experience**
* Demonstrated professional experience designing, analyzing, testing, and troubleshooting **analog or mixed-signal electronic circuits**
* Practical knowledge of analog circuit design, including areas such as **op amps, filters, power conversion, power supplies, sensing, signal conditioning, and control circuitry**
* Experience using schematic capture and circuit simulation tools such as **OrCAD, SPICE, LTspice, or comparable platforms**
* Strong hands-on laboratory skills and experience debugging electronic hardware
* Ability to translate system or product requirements into practical circuit-level designs
* Experience selecting components and evaluating technical tradeoffs involving performance, cost, reliability, availability, and manufacturability
* Ability to independently investigate technical problems, determine root causes, and develop effective solutions
* Experience developing clear engineering documentation and communicating design decisions
* Ability to work effectively across engineering, manufacturing, quality, suppliers, and other technical functions
* Ability to manage multiple engineering assignments and drive work from concept through completion

Experience with **aerospace, defense, military, space, power electronics, embedded hardware, or ruggedized electronic systems** is beneficial but not required.

#### **After Year 1:**

You will be part of a focused team of engineers to perform test, integration, and evaluation of disparate M&S systems and applications to support 5th and 6th generation training interoperability.

The team will work closely with the DoD customer and other Serco teams at Langley AFB and Orlando, FL to deliver quality test services.

* Verify Point Lists and communication interfaces between HVAC equipment and BAS systems.

* Optimize system interoperability and compatibility across devices and networks.

### **Overview:**

The Georgia Tech Research Institute (GTRI) is the nonprofit, applied research division of the Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech). Founded in 1934 as the Engineering Experiment Station, GTRI has grown to more than 2,900 employees, supporting eight laboratories in over 20 locations around the country and performing more than $940 million of problem-solving research annually for government and industry. GTRI's renowned researchers combine science, engineering, economics, policy, and technical expertise to solve complex problems for the U.S. federal government, state, and industry.

### **Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

1. Students are our top priority.
  
2. We strive for excellence.
  
3. We thrive on diversity.
  
4. We celebrate collaboration.
  
5. We champion innovation.
  
6. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.
  
7. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.
  
8. We act ethically.
  
9. We are responsible stewards.

Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.

The Photonics and Microelectronics Division (PMD) in the Electro-Optical Systems Laboratory (EOSL) of GTRI is searching for an early-career Electrical Engineer willing and able to work on multiple projects within the Division, as the need arises, including conducting laboratory experiments, modeling experimental data, and building hardware. GTRI offers a dynamic, collaborative environment, where research faculty generate new ideas for projects to serve the needs of the warfighter and national security, with opportunities to perform on projects outside the division to broaden their knowledge & experience.

The Electrical Engineer designs, develops, and tests electronic circuits fabricated to support a wide range of programs. ---------------

This position focuses on the electrical design and development of custom precision cleaning and wet processing equipment. Our systems support semiconductor manufacturing, electronics, medical devices, and other industries where precision and cleanliness are critical.

The Electrical Controls Engineer is responsible for developing electrical power and control schematics, wiring diagrams, PLC hardware configurations, and technical documentation. This role works closely with mechanical engineering, manufacturing, and project teams to develop reliable, safe, and efficient equipment solutions.

--------------------------

* Develop and maintain bills of materials (BOMs), engineering documentation, and equipment operations and maintenance manuals.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* Ability to read, interpret, and develop electrical schematics and wiring diagrams.

* Familiarity with PLC hardware, including digital and analog inputs and outputs.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

This entry level/early career professional, dual applied science/product systems focused position utilizes the core competencies of thermal and fluid sciences in the specialized areas of combustion and emissions science, using and advancing analytical and experimental approaches to answer key questions about the performance and architecture of a system or component. This drives decisions and creates technical content which ultimately leads to state of the art, highly effective, environmentally friendly, and competitive products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Investigates product, system, and/or technology problems that are related to thermal and fluid sciences, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Applies and supports the improvement of processes such as Pre Program Planning, (PPP), Product Preceding Technology, (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI), or Value Package Change, (VPC), Engineering Standard Work, (ESW), Functional Excellence Practice (FEP)s and tools related to thermal and fluid sciences such as GT-Power, Fluent, Converge, Concerto, CyberApps (virtual application model), Cummins Data Analysis Tool (CDAT), Mach, test data calculation, DARTS, test data storage, Calterm, Electronic Control Module (ECM) calibration tool, Emissions data system, Integrity, and ACCEPTS ECM in-loop test bench required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Obtains input and negotiates with immediate stakeholders, such as team members, technical managers, project leaders, other Thermal Science engineers, product and manufacturing engineers, and supplier partners and delivers information and recommendations to support project decisions, or to provide input related to further analysis, design optimization, feasibility studies, or architecture definition. Makes decisions in the areas of day to day project details, such as conducting analysis, testing, and communication with stakeholders that impact and support the successful progression of projects. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

**Competencies:**

Applies Principles of Combustion and Emissions Science - Interprets and predicts the performance of combustion systems by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive comprehension of the conversion of chemical energy to heat by reacting a fuel with an oxidizer, the formation of exhaust pollutants, modeling tools, controls, and experimental tools to answer key questions about the system or component.

Applies Principles of Fluid Dynamics and Heat Transfer - Interprets and predicts the performance of fluid and thermal systems by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive comprehension of the flow of liquids and gases, the transfer of thermal energy between elements of a system, and the application of modeling and experimental tools, to answer key questions about the system or component.

Applies Principles of Thermodynamics and Energy Conversion Systems - Interprets and predicts the performance of energy conversion systems such as IC engines, gas turbines, fuel cells, and batteries, by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive comprehension of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, modeling tools, controls, and experimental tools to answer key questions about the system or component.

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

SAIC is seeking a highly experienced Lead Systems Engineer (Senior Principal) to support the PMA234 Airborne Electronic Attack (AEA) Systems Program Office, providing direct engineering expertise to the one of several programs within PMA234, the IPT Lead (IPTL), and Class Desk.

In this role, you will guide engineering decisions, conduct rigorous technical evaluations, and coordinate across government, contractor, and stakeholders to ensure system performance, maintainability, and technical compliance. These are high visibility positions that directly influences engineering and programmatic outcomes for critical Navy electronic attack capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Technical Evaluation & Systems Engineering Leadership**  
Lead the review, analysis, and acceptance of engineering documents including SOWs, CDRLs, technical proposals, SETR artifacts, technical maturity assessments, and program requirements compliance.

* ECPs
* Interface Control Documents (ICDs)
* Requirements and requirement changes
* Product Test Verifications
* Investigations, analyses, engineering assessments
* Assist with drafting formal letters, memos, technical evaluations, and other correspondence for the government customer.

* Coordinate with engineering, logistics, fleet support teams (FST), and contractor personnel to resolve technical issues across the system lifecycle.
* Maintain strong communication channels between PMA IPTs, U.S. Navy stakeholders, contractors, and international partners.
* Provide executive level communication, ensuring alignment between engineering teams and Program Leadership.

**Trade Studies, Requirements, and SETR Participation**

* Direct influence on critical Airborne Electronic Attack systems supporting U.S. and international partners.

* Be part of a collaborative, high performing engineering team trusted to deliver on mission-critical requirements.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Engineering** or a related technical/scientific discipline.
* **14+ years** of relevant Systems Engineering experience in DoD, NAVAIR, or similar acquisition environments.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with stakeholders at all levels, both verbally and in writing.

At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Embedded Engineering Manager to build and lead a new embedded team for a next-generation wearable. The team owns the firmware that members interact with directly on the device: how it responds to them, how it presents their data, and how it feels to use every day. It takes that firmware from early prototypes through new product introduction and into production.

This role combines technical leadership with people management. You will lead a team of full-time and contract firmware engineers and grow it as the program scales. You will take part in architecture decisions with the program's technical leads, review the team's code, and own its delivery schedule. You won't be the team's primary developer, but you will be close enough to the code to step in when it helps. You will work closely with Product, Design, Hardware, and Quality, and with the firmware teams building sensors, connectivity, and power on the same device.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Build, manage, and mentor a team of embedded engineers through hiring, onboarding, feedback, performance management, and career development.
* Direct the work of contract engineers alongside full-time staff, holding both to the same design and code quality bar.
* Lead the team's delivery of the member's on-device experience firmware, from prototype through production release.
* Partner with the program's technical lead and senior engineers on architecture for responsive, power-efficient firmware on resource-constrained multi-core hardware.
* Serve as a player-coach who reviews code and shapes designs, contributing directly when the team needs it.
* Own the team's planning and delivery cadence, keeping scope, dependencies, and risk visible to partners and leadership.
* Partner with Product and Design to turn member experience goals into firmware requirements that fit the hardware's memory, compute, and power budgets.
* Set engineering practices for testing, hardware-in-the-loop validation, release readiness, and field diagnostics.
* Foster a culture of high standards, direct feedback, accountability, psychological safety, and continuous learning.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years of embedded firmware development in C or C++, including experience as an engineering manager or team lead responsible for mentorship, feedback, and career development.
* Experience shipping firmware in a consumer electronics product, from early hardware bring-up through production.
* Hands-on experience with an RTOS (Zephyr, FreeRTOS, or similar) on microcontrollers or embedded SoCs.
* Experience optimizing firmware for performance, memory, and power on constrained hardware.
* Demonstrated ability to plan and deliver in ambiguous environments, including early-stage hardware programs where requirements are still forming.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to Product, Design, and leadership.
* Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work meets the same quality bar as personal contributions.

jobs.title: Senior Audio Software Engineer

Category: Engineering

Job ID: R29291

Brand: Bose Corporation, U.S.A

Posted Date: October 18th 2026

widget: Full time

**Description**
---------------

At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

**Job Description**
===================

**Overview**

The audio engineering team is seeking a senior software engineer to lead the development of the tools, frameworks, and infrastructure that enable our acoustics, DSP, and embedded engineering teams to create next-generation audio products.

This role combines software architecture, audio technology, embedded systems, and engineering productivity. You will partner with technical experts across acoustics, signal processing, controls, and embedded systems to build scalable solutions that accelerate research, prototyping, algorithm development, and product realization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and develop software platforms for audio measurement, signal analysis, algorithm development, rapid prototyping, and system characterization.
* Lead the design of frameworks that connect desktop engineering environments with DSPs, embedded processors, audio SoCs, measurement systems, and prototype hardware.
* Drive the evolution of engineering tools, APIs, automation workflows, and visualization environments used across multiple product and technology teams.
* Enable efficient interaction with embedded systems through hardware-control, communication, and digital-audio interfaces.
* Partner closely with engineers to understand workflow challenges, develop solutions, and improve development velocity and experimentation efficiency.
* Provide technical leadership in software architecture, development practices, testing, deployment, and long-term maintainability.
* Debug and optimize end-to-end audio systems spanning software, firmware, hardware, and measurement environments.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to the growth of a strong engineering-tools ecosystem across Bose.

**Required Qualifications**

* BS/MS in Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Acoustics, DSP, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience developing engineering software, technical computing applications, embedded systems, or audio/DSP solutions.
* Demonstrated programming skills in Python with experience in C/C++ development. Application knowledge of Matlab and LLM is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of digital signal processing, real-time audio systems, and engineering measurement methodologies.
* Experience designing scalable, maintainable software architectures used by multiple teams or products. Version control (Git) and collaboration is implied.
* Experience interfacing software with embedded systems, laboratory instrumentation, or data-acquisition platforms.
* Deep knowledge of modern software-development practices including source control, automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, packaging, and release management.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and technical leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Active Noise Reduction (ANR), acoustics, audio DSP, control systems, or adaptive signal processing.
* Experience with embedded DSPs, microcontrollers, real-time operating systems, and audio SoCs.
* Familiarity with audio and hardware communication interfaces such as USB, TCP/IP, I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, I2S, TDM, PDM, and A2B.
* Experience with data-acquisition systems such as Audio Precision, National Instruments, or similar audio-measurement hardware.
* Experience developing enterprise-scale engineering toolchains, frameworks, SDKs, or technical computing environments.
* Strong working knowledge of Linux and cross-platform software development.
* Passion for audio technology and creating tools that significantly improve engineering productivity.

**Why This Role Matters**

The platforms and tools you develop will be used by engineers across Bose to explore new concepts, validate algorithms, characterize complex acoustic systems, and transition innovations from research into products. Your work will directly influence the speed, quality, and effectiveness of audio technology development across the company.

This is an opportunity to shape the engineering infrastructure behind the next generation of Bose products while collaborating with world-class experts in acoustics, DSP, embedded systems, and software engineering.

  
At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! jobs.title: Senior Staff Systems Engineer, Embedded Safety
jobs.description:
Boston Dynamics is looking for a **Senior Staff Systems Engineer, Embedded Safety** on the **Safer Robotics Team** . You will join a cross-functional group developing safe, reliable, and reactive robotic technologies that enable mobile robots to operate alongside humans in complex environments. In this role, you will lead the systems engineering methodology—spanning requirements generation, structured safety analysis, and architecture trade studies—specifically focused on MCU/MPU-based embedded systems and safety-critical firmware.

  

You will serve as the central technical bridge unifying hardware constraints, firmware execution, and test validation. Working at the intersection of systems engineering, embedded software, and test infrastructure, you will collaborate closely with Safety Firmware Engineers during board bring-up and driver development, as well as Staff Firmware Test Engineers building HIL/SIL validation frameworks.

  

Boston Dynamics is a world leader in mobile robots, tackling some of the toughest robotics challenges. For years, our awe-inspiring viral videos on YouTube have shown the world what remarkably capable robots can do. Now we are quickly becoming a recognized leader in automation solutions for industrial applications and warehouse logistics.

  

**How you will make an impact:**

  

* Lead cross-functional systems engineering initiatives to establish embedded system architectures, firmware requirements, and technical development plans for safe autonomous robotic platforms.
* Solicit stakeholder needs and derive, author, and parameterize clear system, firmware, and low-level software requirements.
* Establish and maintain end-to-end requirements-to-verification traceability pipelines across tools such as Jama, Jira, Git, and automated test frameworks.
* Partner closely with Safety Firmware Engineers to define requirements for functional safety features, diagnostic logic and interfaces for low-level communication protocols (SPI, I2C, CAN, UART, Ethernet).
* Collaborate directly with Firmware Test Engineers to translate safety goals and system requirements into verifiable HIL/SIL test plans, fault injection coverage, and CI/CD automated test suites.
* Guide cross-functional teams through structured safety and risk analyses—including HARA, FMEA, and Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)—to systematically identify edge cases in timing, communication, and fault handling.
Compile requirements, analysis, and verification evidence required to support a comprehensive safety case for autonomous robotic systems.  

  

**What You Bring:**

  

* 7+ years of experience in systems engineering, embedded software/firmware development, or firmware validation for complex mechatronic or safety-critical robotic systems.
* Fluent technical command of software engineering tools, including Git version control, Linux environments, Jira, and requirements management platforms such as Jama.
* Proficiency in C/C++ for embedded firmware as well as Python (including pytest ecosystems) to effectively engage with both firmware development and test automation tooling.
* Deep familiarity with relevant safety standards (e.g., IEC 61508, ISO 26262, or IEC 62304) and experience compiling data to support safety claims.
* Strong ability to read electrical schematics, datasheets, and low-level protocol payloads (SPI, I2C, CAN, UART, Ethernet) to ensure hardware intent matches firmware behavior.
* Demonstrated experience acting as a technical liaison between firmware development teams and product development teams.
Exceptional written and verbal communication, cross-functional collaboration, and conflict resolution skills.  

  

**Nice to Have Skills:**

  

* Experience with firmware coding standards like MISRA C/C++.
* Experience with static and dynamic analysis software tools.
* Familiarity with software and hardware testing for HIL/SIL environments.
* Experience with embedded Linux (kernel and user space), real-time operating systems (RTOS), and hardware debuggers/trace equipment (J-Link, Lauterbach, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers).
Hands-on familiarity with electro-mechanical actuation subsystems, including motor controllers, encoders, and power/current sensing.  

  

*We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.*

  

*The salary range for this position will be clearly stated in the job posting as required by Massachusetts law. The base pay range for this position is between $155,000 - $193,000. Base pay will depend on multiple individualized factors including, but not limited to internal equity, job related knowledge, skills and experience. This range represents a good faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting.*

  

**Boston Dynamics will never ask you to divulge your personal financial or account information as part of its recruiting process.**
