jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer
jobs.description:
**About CircuitHub**
--------------------

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

**The role**
------------

Mechatronics Engineers at CircuitHub own projects end to end. You'll start with a problem, often on our factory floor, and take it all the way to a working machine:

* Understand the problem and turn it into a clear specification
* Generate ideas and choose the right mechanism
* Design it in CAD and prove it out with the engineering calculations
* Prototype and build it, machining parts in our in-house CNC shop
* Bring it to life with software on our in-house robotics operating system

We work AI-first. AI tools help you scope the problem, drive your CAD, run the calculations and write the machine software. The software side needs basic software engineering skills, not a software background: you'll write it with AI agents, supported by a dedicated software engineering team who build the operating system.

You must have built things before, ideally robots, whether as a hobbyist, student, employee or founder. We don't hire narrow specialists. We want engineers who can:

* Diagnose system-wide failures from first principles
* Prototype mechanical and software fixes on the fly
* Work autonomously and communicate clearly with a team spread across sites
* Take responsibility for how their machines perform in live production

**Things you'll do**
--------------------

This is a design role with hands-on prototyping. For example:

* Conceive new mechanisms to handle electronics parts and other robotic handling tasks, using AI to scope and specify the problem
* Design gantries and end effectors in Fusion 360
* Use AI agents to run the engineering calculations, and know when to distrust them
* Machine prototype parts in our in-house CNC shop
* Analyse end-effector behaviour from video and revise its geometry and control approach to improve throughput and reliability
* Program machine behaviour on our in-house robotics operating system, with AI agents doing the heavy lifting
* Specify sensors that catch errors while a machine is running, or monitor a chemical process
* Prototype and deploy a new test robot for in-line PCB validation
* Commission your machines and hand them over to our build team to scale up
* Work across our US and UK sites to share what you've learned and shape the roadmap

**Bonus skills**
----------------

* Experience programming machines, whether PLCs, robot controllers, embedded systems or Python
* Programming and running CNC machinery
* Design of chemical handling machinery
* Optics

**Pay and level**
-----------------

$80K–$200K depending on experience, plus equity.

A candidate at the lower end of the range might have:

* Built some systems before, with some exposure to robotics or automation
* Seen parts and subsystems through to manufacture as part of a design team
* Knowledge of designing for machining
* A keen interest in moving their career towards practical robotics

A candidate at the upper end might also have:

* Led the build and deployment of large-scale automated systems
* Written the software that controls their own machines
* Designed for a wide range of manufacturing methods, from machining to sheet metal to injection moulding
* Mentored more junior engineers

The range isn't a hard limit: if you're an expert in all of the above, we still want to talk to you. Not quite so experienced but passionate and keen to learn? Talk to us too.

**Location**
------------

Full-time on-site at our factory in South Deerfield, Western Massachusetts, 90 minutes from Boston, where the Grid runs in production today.

Compensation Range: $80K - $200K

jobs.title: Junior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About Us**

At Pickle Robot, we're on a mission to automate global supply chains with Physical AI. Our robots work alongside warehouse teams to unload trucks and containers — one of the toughest, most understaffed jobs in logistics — making the work safer, faster, and more efficient for the people doing it. Loading trucks comes next, followed by the Dill Autonomy Engine: generalized autonomy that will eventually orchestrate robots across entire logistics processes.

We’re looking for a Junior Systems Engineer to join the team that defines what our robotic unloading systems must do and proves that they do it. Physical AI earns its place on a loading dock only when it is specified, traced, and verified like any other engineered system, and that’s the work this team does.

You’ll write and maintain system requirements, trace them from product needs through testing, and help author the design documents and interface definitions that let hardware and software teams build to a shared contract. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and our System Verification and Test team, and spend time with the robots so your requirements reflect how the system actually behaves. You’ll see that work tested on robots in our warehouse and at customer sites.

This role suits someone early in their career who likes structure, asks precise questions, and wants to learn how a complex robot comes together across mechanical, electrical, software, and test.

### **What You'll Do**

* Write and maintain clear, measurable, testable system requirements, and keep the requirements register accurate as designs change.
* Trace product requirements to system requirements and test cases, identify coverage gaps, and drive them to closure.
* Prepare requirements for review and approval with Engineering, Test, and Systems, and work through feedback and rejections to resolution.
* Work with the System Verification and Test team to ensure test cases trace to requirements and that verification coverage is complete.
* Write feature requirements documents that define how each feature works across the robot's subsystems, and help develop cross-functional design solutions with mechanical, electrical, and software teams.

### **What You'll Bring**

* Typically 0-3 years of experience in systems engineering, robotics, or a related engineering role. New graduates are welcome; 1-2 years of industry experience is a plus.
* Strong sense of ownership: you take a problem, see it through to completion, and make things happen without waiting to be asked.
* Internship, co-op, or student project experience (for example, competition teams or capstone projects) where you defined requirements, ran tests, or integrated hardware and software.
* Precise technical writer who can turn an ambiguous need into a requirement someone can build and test against.
* Organized and detail-oriented, comfortable keeping a large body of requirements consistent and up to date.
* Curious about how mechanical, electrical, and software subsystems interact, and willing to dig into the details of each.
* Clear communicator who works well with cross-functional teams and contributes thoughtfully to design reviews.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering preferred; degrees in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field will be considered alongside relevant systems engineering experience.
* Onsite presence is expected at least 3 days per week at our Charlestown, MA offices to stay close to the hardware.

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with Jira or a similar tracking tool
* Exposure to requirements management or test planning
* Python scripting
* Experience with robots or other hardware in a production setting

### **Pay at Pickle**

At Pickle Robot Company, we believe transparency builds trust. The salary range listed here is provided in accordance with Massachusetts law and reflects what we reasonably and in good faith expect to offer for this role. We often consider candidates at different levels of seniority, and final compensation will reflect the level at which a candidate is hired, along with factors like experience and location.

### **Pickle Perks**

Pickle provides best-in-class benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited vacation; paid federal and state holidays; 401(k) contributions of 5% of your salary; company-covered travel expenses; and other perks to make your working life more fun, comfortable, and productive.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. * Assemble, wire, test, and troubleshoot electrical and electromechanical equipment.
* Integrate sensors, motors, power supplies, and control systems.
* Diagnose problems across electrical, mechanical, and software interfaces.
* Improve equipment reliability, serviceability, and ease of operation.
* Create and maintain wiring diagrams, assembly instructions, and troubleshooting notes.
* Work closely with the team to bring equipment improvements from concept through testing.

**What we’re looking for**

* An electrical engineering background with practical hardware experience.
* Confidence reading schematics and using electrical test equipment.
* A methodical approach to troubleshooting and safe work habits.
* Comfort using tools, assembling machines, and working through unfamiliar problems.
* Clear communication, careful documentation, and ownership of your work.

**Experience that would stand out**

* Semiconductor equipment or manufacturing.
* Controls and automation, including PLCs or industrial controllers.
* Machine building, commissioning, or equipment maintenance.
* Integrating sensors, motion systems, or data acquisition.
* CAD, electrical schematic design, or programming for equipment control.

You don’t need every item on this list. We’re especially interested in evidence that you can build, troubleshoot, and improve real equipment.

Apply through Indeed with your résumé. Include a few sentences about a machine or hardware project you built, repaired, or improved—your contribution, the hardest problem, and how you solved it. Photos or a portfolio are welcome if you can share them.

Pay: $90,000.00 - $140,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer, Client Platform Engineer, ChromeOS
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) manages the devices Anthropic’s people work on, plus the infrastructure underneath them. We treat the fleet as a distributed platform, not a collection of devices, and configuration ships as code through pull requests, CI, staging, and a canary group. Today the fleet is mostly macOS, with a growing mobile footprint.

Anthropic also works with vendor and business process outsourcing (BPO) partners whose teams need access to Anthropic systems. Those programs are growing, in more countries and with more vendors. Anthropic-owned Chromebooks issued to vendor staff are becoming the default device for vendor teams. This role exists to make ChromeOS a supported platform with a dedicated owner. You will own ChromeOS end to end, from how devices are bought and enrolled to how they are locked down, monitored, and retired, and help bring Android in as a second platform.

The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You’ll define what ChromeOS looks like at Anthropic and own the platform decisions that get it there.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own ChromeOS as a platform at Anthropic: device standards, Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise setup, organizational unit design, and policy
* Manage ChromeOS policy as code through the Chrome Policy API, GAM, and Terraform, in the team's config-as-code pipeline, so changes are reviewed, tested, and progressively rolled out like the rest of the fleet
* Build zero touch enrollment through resellers, so a Chromebook arrives enrolled and works the first time in every country our vendor partners work from
* Work with IT Operations and procurement partners on buying and shipping devices internationally, including regions our current partners don’t reach
* Design device models for vendor teams (kiosk, managed guest sessions, shared devices, and assigned devices) and pick the right one for each program
* Lock devices down to what the work needs: copy and paste, downloads, printing, USB, and app and extension controls
* Own the device lifecycle for vendor fleets, from enrollment to wipe, lock, and retrieval when an engagement ends
* Feed ChromeOS device data into our fleet telemetry, tracking which devices are checking in, OS version, and drift between expected and actual state
* Partner with Corporate Security on hardware standards (such as Verified Access attestation and minimum AUE date), device trust signals, and access decisions
* Work with Security on the contractor access model and on keeping Anthropic data off vendor devices
* Run data loss controls through Chrome Enterprise Premium
* Work with Security on the vendor identity model: which accounts vendor staff use and in which tenant
* Support Android as a second platform, working with the corporate mobile program on Android Enterprise and zero-touch enrollment
* Write the runbooks IT Operations and vendor partners use to stand up a new program

**You may be a good fit if you**
--------------------------------

* Have owned ChromeOS as a platform for a fleet of thousands of devices
* Know the Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise well: OU design, device and user policy, enrollment, and reporting
* Have automated ChromeOS policy through the Chrome Policy API or GAM
* Have run kiosk, managed guest, or shared device programs for frontline, contact center, or outsourced teams
* Have set up zero touch enrollment with resellers and shipped devices across several countries
* Have worked with Android device management and can hold your own in a mixed fleet
* Excel at ambiguous problems that touch several teams at once
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to any audience, including vendor partners
* View IT Engineering as requiring product engineering rigor
* Write clear documentation as a natural part of your workflow

**Strong candidates may also**
------------------------------

* Manage device configuration as code (pull requests, CI, staged rollout) instead of clicking in consoles
* Have managed ChromeOS alongside macOS or mobile fleets
* Have used VDI or browser-based access to keep data off the device for outsourced teams
* Have supported BPO or vendor programs through fast growth into new regions
* Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry
* Have used LLMs to automate operational work, or are excited to make Claude a teammate

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* Python and shell scripting
* ChromeOS management through the Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise
* Google Admin SDK, Chrome Policy API, and GAM for automating policy and reporting
* Android Enterprise management (working knowledge)
* Querying live device state at fleet scale
* GitOps and CI for configuration management
* Endpoint security fundamentals

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$325,000 - $360,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requiremen

jobs.description:
**Job Title**
=============

Automation Engineer

**Job Description Summary**
===========================

**Job Description**
===================

At C&W Services, we live by the belief that “Better Never Settles.” We're dedicated to creating a positive impact globally and we're looking for talented individuals to join our team.

**C&W Services provides compelling benefits, including:**

* Weekly pay
* Comprehensive benefits starting on your first day
* Training, development, and advancement opportunities
* A clean and cutting-edge facility
* A safety-first culture

**About the Role:**

As an Automation Engineer (AE), you will support the site maintenance team to ensure operational performance and efficiency of Material Handling Equipment (MHE) control systems. You will partner with the maintenance team to troubleshoot and maintain equipment such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print-and-apply labeling systems, scales, HMI systems, control cabinets, and more. The AE provides support to the operations and maintenance teams by implementing solutions for complex problems and tracking related projects. You may lead and/or assist other technicians with their development through continuity of knowledge, all while working in a clean, climate-controlled, modern facility.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Promoting a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
* Providing guidance on maintaining material handling control systems, industrial motor control systems, servo and frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* Using your technical expertise to provide support with troubleshooting and modifying software projects for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley ControlLogix and CompactLogix PLC platform utilizing Rockwell’s software package, industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems.
* Acting as the first level of escalation support for equipment automation issues and appropriately escalating downtime situations to vendors and/or network support teams to restore equipment operation.
* Applying subject matter expertise in material handling and electronic control systems to maximize building utilization of systems
* Monitoring MHE metrics and partnering with mechatronics technicians to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies, and performing control systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability
* Partnering with facility Operations leadership, equipment vendors, and parts suppliers to plan and coordinate new technology installations, acting as the technical consultant for capital projects inside the building
* Communicating technical issues and project timelines with building leadership, operations, and the maintenance team, explaining production impacts and working closely with operations and engineering to ensure a thorough understanding of impact to systems

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of cumulative work experience in the following areas, or a relevant 2-year degree plus 1 year of work experience in the following areas:
  + Programming/commissioning of HMIs, PLCs, and VFDs
  + SCADA systems and KPIs
  + Interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings
  + Supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems
  + Equipment control components such as relays, motor starters, VFDs, HMIs, etc.
* High school or equivalent diploma
* Positive attitude and ability to effectively problem-solve

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Associate’s degree with a focus in Electronic Technology (or similar)
* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM-related field
* 4+ years of experience in the electrical field, or in control systems development, troubleshooting, and programming
* 4+ years of experience supporting advanced automation controls systems maintenance and development
* 3+ years of experience supporting a wide range of conveyors and sortation systems
* Leadership and project management experience

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to reach overhead, kneel, squat, climb steps/ladders, use an aerial lift, and frequently lift a maximum of 50 lbs. of equipment
* Ability to perform tasks while wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), which may include but is not limited to hard hat, face mask, face shield, and composite-toe shoes
* Regularly required to crouch or bend and reach to install/move equipment
* Movement between departments, floors, and properties to facilitate work, averaging 6 to 12 miles per day
* Work in a warehouse environment with fluctuating temperatures
* Regularly required to type on a computer for 1-2 hours per day

**Why C&W Services?**

We're a global company with over 400 offices in 60 countries. We're proud of our diverse family of employees and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We're recognized by the Human Rights Foundation as a Best Place to Work for LGBTQI+ individuals and are dedicated to continuing to build a culture of inclusion and respect.

**What’s Next?**

Ready to take the next steps in your career? Apply today and be part of a team that is making a difference!

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

  

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

  
  

**What We Offer**

  

Salary:

$120,000.00 - $165,000.00

Location:

Gloucester,MA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .

  
As a Systems Engineer, you’ll design, integrate, and optimize complex systems that drive the semiconductor industry forward. Your expertise in systems thinking and problem-solving is essential as you collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop advanced solutions to intricate processes and writing system specifications. You’ll be responsible for analyzing requirements, defining system architectures, conducting thorough testing, and ensuring seamless integration of subsystems. Additionally, you’ll identify and mitigate risks, confirming that our systems meet the highest quality standards and exceed customer expectations.  

**Role Responsibilities:**

* Complete definition and design of complex components, modules, and sub systems. Contribute to the system engineering specification both within the field of expertise and broaden into other disciplines. Ensure designs meet market requirement specifications (MRS).
* Coordinate with project marketing and management to understand sub system requirements.
* Lead architecture brainstorming meetings and drive the systems process to down select to a final architecture of a subsystem
* Conduct detailed engineering analysis of sub systems using vast knowledge of design concepts and functional requirements in field of technical expertise and broaden into other disciplines.
* Assist in creating concepts for architectural design approaches. Evaluate architectures to provide recommendation for best system solution approach
* Build and qualify prototypes of new designs, or procure entire subsystems from outsourced suppliers and test for compliance with detailed specifications
* Identify and troubleshoot a variety of difficult engineering problems in field of technical expertise, including serviceability and manufacturability.
* Support System Integration during the assembly and final testing of new product designs.
* Perform and coordinate tests against internal and industry-accepted reliability specifications. Make suitable design or operational changes as required.
* Support system engineering projects that have a substantial mix of electrical, mechanical, physics, algorithms and software design, and understand the underlying system implications.
* Provide remote and onsite support to field support personnel as required.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 4-7 years of experience

**Additional Information**

**Time Type:**

Full time

**Employee Type:**

Assignee / Regular

Yes, 10% of the Time

**Relocation Eligible:**

No

For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement.

jobs.title: Senior Computer Vision Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

We have a new opportunity for a Senior Software Development Engineer to join our Engineering team. In this role you will be working within a collaborative team on the development of next generation non-contacting measurement technologies and processes for video extensometer products. You will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced algorithms and systems and will have deep expertise across optical and imaging system design, and high‑performance, real‑time software implementation. The successful candidate will serve as both a technical authority and hands‑on contributor, working across algorithm development, computational performance optimization, and integration with imaging hardware. This role plays a critical part in delivering robust, production‑grade solutions used in demanding real‑time and high‑accuracy measurement applications.

*Key Responsibilities*

  

* Collaborate on the design and selection of optical systems, including lenses, cameras, illumination, and stereo configurations.
* Design, implement, and maintain image analysis techniques and algorithms
* Develop and refine correlation metrics, interpolation schemes and strain calculation methods.
* Contribute to camera calibration, stereo reconstruction, and geometric correction
* Understand and optimize performance tradeoffs across resolution, frame rate, depth of field, and signal‑to‑noise ratio.
* Work closely with hardware teams to ensure seamless integration between imaging systems and DIC software.
* Optimize software for real‑time or near real‑time execution, including low‑latency processing pipelines.
* Apply performance optimization techniques such as multi‑threading, SIMD/vectorization, GPU acceleration (e.g., CUDA/OpenCL), and memory‑efficient architectures.
* Profile and benchmark code to identify and eliminate computational bottlenecks.
* Balance accuracy, robustness, and execution speed for production deployment

*Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:*

* Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Vision, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related field
* Extensive hands‑on experience with machine vision software development, including practical deployment on real imaging systems.
* Strong foundation in computer vision, numerical methods, optimization, and image processing.
* Proven experience developing high‑performance, production‑quality software for computationally intensive applications.
* Ability to prototype algorithms in Matlab and deploy production implementations in C++
* Demonstrated ability to optimize software for speed, memory efficiency, and robustness.
* Desired attributes:
  + Proven strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills
  + Able to create, collaborate and work within team environments.
  + Innovative with strong problem-solving capabilities.
  + Self-starter showing front to back ownership and sense of urgency

*Preferred:*

* Real-time machine vision measurement systems in aerospace, automotive, biomechanics, materials testing, or similar domains.
* GPU acceleration and heterogeneous computing architectures.
* Familiarity with uncertainty quantification or metrology standards
* Experience delivering commercial or customer‑deployed scientific software products.
* Familiarity with material testing systems

**Compensation Information:**

This position has a starting salary range of $140,000 to $160,000 per year and is incentive eligible. Pay is determined by several factors, including a candidate’s experience, relevant skills, and qualifications

*As an equal employment opportunity employer, ITW is committed to equal employment opportunity and fair treatment for employees, beginning with the hiring process and continuing through all aspects of the employment relationship.*

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.*

* 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.  
  
With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

The Regulatory, Compliance, and Policy (RCP) team works on high profile, critical, compliance (policies and regulatory responses) and regulatory-adjacent data sharing obligations across Search+. In order to comply with ongoing requirements, we build scalable infrastructure, partnering closely across Search and with several product areas across Google.

The team is facing new exciting challenges in our space, taking on data sharing obligations in Google's traffic acquisition commitments, ensuring that Search (and Google) accurately implement processes and pipelines to fulfill our obligations.

In our team, you'll be managing both internal and external stakeholders, and build infrastructure for problems that haven't been solved previously at Google. You will operate in a fast-paced and forever changing landscape where we need to balance building the right infrastructure with adhering to challenging timelines and requirements.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Electrical Engineering
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Please note that this position is not available for visa sponsorship, and we are unable to take over existing employment visa sponsorships.**

**POSITION SUMMARY**
--------------------

TransMedics is transforming organ transplant therapy with the Organ Care System (OCS)—the first portable warm-perfusion platform that keeps donor organs living and functioning outside the body. It's technology built to give more patients a chance at a transplant, and more transplant teams the confidence to say yes to an organ they'd otherwise have to turn away.

As TransMedics pushes into the next generation of OCS technology, the Sr. Director of Electrical Engineering will own the electrical architecture, design, and test strategy that brings that technology to life—from early concept through cleared, shipping product. This is a senior leadership role with a seat on the R&D leadership staff, shaping the long-range technical strategy and capability roadmap that will define TransMedics next decade of innovation.

This is a build role, not a maintain role. TransMedics is scaling fast, and the electrical engineering organization needs a leader who can build the team, systems, and capabilities to match that growth—while staying close enough to the technical details to step into a design review, unblock a verification failure, or work a supplier issue personally when it matters. We're looking for someone equally comfortable setting a three-year capability roadmap and sitting shoulder-to-shoulder with an engineer debugging a board.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
--------------------

* **Set department strategy —** define the long-range strategy and capability roadmap for Electrical Engineering within R&D, including the skills, tools, and infrastructure needed to support TransMedics next phase of growth.
* **Own electrical architecture —** lead architecture, design, and testing for next-generation Organ Care Systems, ensuring every design meets project requirements and regulatory standards.
* **Lead design teams —** provide leadership, oversight, and technical guidance to internal and external design teams across new product development.
* **Stay hands-on —** bring a hands-on approach to electrical engineering strategy, prototyping, and design, for both new products and the products already in the field today.
* **Own design requirements —** lead the team through definition of electrical design requirements and specifications for new products.
* **Drive design rigor —** own documentation practices including cross-functional design reviews, theory of operation, DFMEA, and complete release packages (fabrication and assembly drawings, Gerber packages, and source files).
* **Lead verification —** own the verification strategy for electrical subsystem designs, including protocol and report generation across internal and external test labs.
* **Support supply relationships —** Lead the support of contract manufacturers for supply of PCBAs and components.
* **Own goals & planning —** set and monitor department goals aligned to corporate and project objectives, and own project planning, budgeting, and scheduling for the team.
* **Partner cross-functionally —** work closely with Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Regulatory, and Clinical to keep programs moving.

**Strategic Focus Areas**

* **Technical Strategy & Roadmap —** define the electrical architecture and capability roadmap for next-generation OCS platforms.
* **Design Excellence & Compliance —** ensure every design meets safety and EMC requirements (IEC 60601, RTCA DO-160) the first time.
* **Hands-On Technical Leadership —** stay close enough to the work to personally guide a design review or unblock a verification issue.
* **Team Building & Development —** grow a high-performing electrical engineering organization built to scale with the company.
* **Cross-Functional Partnership —** work seamlessly with Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory, and Clinical to bring products to market.

**MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES**
-------------------------------

  

* Direct management of the Electrical Engineering department, including performance reviews and professional development planning.
* Oversight of design contractors, co-ops, and interns as needed.

**PHYSICAL ATTRIBUTES**

  

* In-office environment.
* Ability to lift to 25 lbs.
* May travel up to 10% domestically.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------

  

* BS in Electrical Engineering plus 10+ years of electrical design experience for medical devices, including 10+ years managing an engineering team.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

  

* Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in Electrical Engineering.

jobs.description:
**Job Title**

Automation Design Engineer

– Automotive Welding

**Job Summary**

You will design, develop, and test automated welding systems and robotic tooling for automotive manufacturing. Your work includes creating 3D models, selecting automation equipment, and ensuring designs meet safety and customer standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Design Systems:** Create 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings for robotic welding cells, end-of-arm tooling, and assembly fixtures using CAD software like SolidWorks or AutoCAD.
* **Integrate Robotics:** Select and integrate industrial robots, welding guns (MIG, TIG, Resistance/Spot), sensors, and safety hardware.
* **Collaborate:** Work with project managers, controls engineers, and the shop floor to ensure designs are practical and buildable.
* **Review Safety:** Ensure all mechanical and automation designs follow OSHA, RIA, and customer-specific safety standards.
* **Support Build & Launch:** Assist with assembly troubleshooting, robot path simulations, and final buy-off at customer sites if needed.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Experience:** 3 to 5 years of experience in automation design, specifically within the automotive or tier-1 welding supplier industry.
* **Software Skills:** Proficiency in 3D CAD software (SolidWorks, CATIA, or Inventor) and robotic simulation tools (Robcad or Process Simulate).
* **Knowledge Base:** Strong understanding of resistance spot welding, MIG welding, pneumatic components, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).

**Job Title:** Process Automation Design Engineer

– Automotive Welding Systems

**Department:** Process Engineering / Automation

**Reports To:** Engineering Manager

**Position Summary:**

The Process Automation Design Engineer is responsible for designing, simulating, and optimizing complete automated welding manufacturing lines. This role focuses on the macro-level process layout, material flow, cycle-time (thru-put) analysis, and the high-level integration of FANUC robotic arms into coherent production cells.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Process & Layout Design:** Develop 2D/3D manufacturing line layouts, sequence of operations, and process flow diagrams for robotic MIG, spot, and laser welding cells.
* **FANUC Robot Simulation:** Utilize simulation software (such as FANUC ROBOGUIDE or Process Simulate) to perform reach studies, interference checks, and cycle time analysis.
* **System Integration:** Define the interaction between FANUC robots, material handling systems, safety gating, and PLC-controlled equipment.
* **Cycle Time Optimization:** Analyze and optimize robot paths and process steps to meet strict automotive customer throughput requirements.
* **Specifications & Standards:** Ensure all process designs comply with automotive OEM specifications (e.g., Ford, GM, Stellantis) and safety standards (RIA/OSHA).
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Tooling Design Engineers to align fixture placement with robot access paths and process constraints.

**Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Automation Engineering.
* **Experience:** 3+ years in automotive process automation design, focusing on robotic welding lines.
* **Technical Skills:** High proficiency in FANUC ROBOGUIDE, AutoCAD, and 3D CAD platforms. Deep knowledge of MIG/MAG and resistance spot welding parameters.
* **Knowledge:** Strong understanding of automotive assembly line routing, safety circuits, and line balancing.

**Job Title:** Tooling Automation Design Engineer

– Welding & FANUC

**Department:** Mechanical Design / Tooling

**Reports To:** Tooling Engineering Supervisor

**Position Summary:**

The Tooling Automation Design Engineer is responsible for the mechanical design of welding fixtures, clamping systems, and specialized End-of-Arm Tooling (EOAT) for FANUC robots. This role ensures parts are held precisely to meet tight tolerances during high-stress robotic welding applications.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Fixture & Tooling Design:** Design 3D geometric welding fixtures, manual/pneumatic clamping systems, and heavy-duty robotic EOAT using SolidWorks, CATIA, or NX.
* **FANUC Payload & Center of Gravity (CG) Analysis:** Calculate load capacities, moments of inertia, and CG for EOAT to ensure compliance with specific FANUC robot payload profiles.
* **Component Selection:** Specify standard automation components including pneumatic cylinders, toggle clamps, proximity sensors, grippers, and slide units.
* **GD&T Application:** Apply strict Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) to fabrication prints to ensure part repeatability and quality.
* **Welding Environment Design:** Material selection and shielding design to withstand weld spatter, high heat, and harsh production environments.
* **Build Support:** Support the toolroom build, assembly, shim-tuning, and try-out phases of fixtures and EOAT.

**Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Tool & Die Design, or equivalent trade experience.
* **Experience:** 3+ years designing physical tooling, fixtures, and robotic grippers for automotive body-in-white (BIW) welding applications.
* **Technical Skills:** Advanced 3D CAD modeling skills (SolidWorks preferred); strong knowledge of pneumatics and fluid power schematics.
* **Knowledge:** Deep understanding of FANUC robot mechanical mounting interfaces and payload constraints.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Space Physics Research Laboratory (SPRL) in the College of Engineering is seeking an experienced, highly motivated Electrical Engineer to provide technical and project support for current and future space mission and instrument development projects.

SPRL is a College of Engineering research facility that serves faculty, government agencies (such as NASA and DoD), and industry in the development of unique integrated systems and instrumentation that are often used in challenging environments ( e.g. space, arctic, above/on/below the water). The SPRL professional staff, with faculty and researchers, have built more than 35 space systems and instruments; instrumented numerous sounding rockets, balloons and aircraft; and developed ground-based instruments. For eight decades, University of Michigan has been one of a handful of universities able to conceive, design, construct, test, and operate space flight instruments - a truly 'end-to-end' operation.

The Engineer in Research Intermediate will develop and design analog, analog-to-digital, and power-system electronics in particular, and assume primary responsibility for the design of instrument modules and support subsystems. They will design, specify, and test hardware and software used in those systems and prepare test and integration plans for all phases of electronic hardware development. In addition, they will participate in the development of proposals for new research opportunities, participate in sponsor and project-level review meetings representing the University and principal investigator interests. They will also evaluate hardware and software designs for correctness and applicability to overall design requirements.

**Responsibilities\***
----------------------

* Design of electrical systems and analog components for instruments, including neutral and ion mass spectrometers and energetic particle detectors, ion thruster components, magnetometers and other spacecraft components and instruments.
* Ability to perform parts stress, power dissipation, and thermal stress analysis of instrument and small satellite electrical designs.
* Knowledge and experience of the testing and verification of electrical components or assemblies.
* Knowledge and experience in the proper design of electrical components for space systems, including vacuum, thermal, materials, and other considerations.
* Knowledge and experience with the challenges of the space environment and other harsh environments to inform PCB layout, component selection and placement, radiation effects mitigation, signal integrity, and thermal cycling.
* Knowledge of standard design tools such as Altium and LTSpice.

**Required Qualifications\***
-----------------------------

* BS in Electrical Engineering
* Demonstrated excellence in team cooperation, organization, and communication skills.
* One to three years of experience in the development, design, integration, and testing of electronics used in scientific instrumentation for air and spaceborne environments
* Design experience in analog electronics, analog-to-digital, power systems, and sensor systems to inform circuit design, PCB layout, assembly, and testing.
* This position requires access to technology controlled under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) or Export Administration Regulations (EAR). To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, candidates must qualify as a 'U.S. Person,' which includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and certain protected individuals (such as refugees or asylees) as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required export authorization from the U.S. government.

**Desired Qualifications\***

* Master's degree in Electrical Engineering
* 5 years of experience in developing flight or flight development hardware for NASA or DoD applications, such as mass spectrometers, magnetometers, etc.
* Experience in analog, analog-to-digital, power system, and/or sensor design. and sensitive signal amplification design experience
* Cognizant engineer experience in organizing and planning electronics contributions for instrument and avionics projects
* Experience in the preparation of technical and cost proposals for government-sponsored projects

jobs.title: Experienced Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Build custom machines that turn demanding manufacturing requirements into working automation.
  
  
PAR Systems is seeking a Controls Engineer with a strong Beckhoff background to join our Advanced Manufacturing team. Our systems support challenging aerospace and defense applications, including precision cutting and trimming, robotic and configurable fixtures, drilling, and friction stir welding. In this role, you will develop controls and software for custom machines where coordinated motion, process control, and reliable operation are essential. You will bring hands-on TwinCAT experience to project delivery while helping expand our Beckhoff expertise, reusable software, and engineering practices.
  
  
We welcome candidates at the Advanced or Senior Engineer level. Placement will reflect your technical depth, independence, project ownership, and ability to guide others.
  
  
What you’ll do
  

* Translate customer and machine requirements into controls architectures, software designs, and test plans.
* Develop modular, maintainable machine-control software using Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 and IEC 61131-3 Structured Text.
* Configure and commission Beckhoff controllers, EtherCAT networks, I/O, servo drives, and connected devices.
* Implement and tune motion control, including axis sequencing, synchronization, and coordinated movement.
* Develop machine operating modes, process sequences, interlocks, alarms, diagnostics, and recovery behavior.
* Integrate operator interfaces, instrumentation, robots, and PC applications with the machine-control system.
* Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, software, and process engineers to resolve system interfaces and design challenges.
* Test software through simulation and staged integration, then support machine power-up, debugging, Factory Acceptance Testing, and customer-site commissioning.
* Troubleshoot issues across software, electrical hardware, motion systems, and manufacturing processes.
* Contribute reusable libraries, coding standards, documentation, and technical reviews. Share your Beckhoff knowledge and mentor other engineers.

What you bring
  

* A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.
* Typically five or more years of controls or automation engineering experience, with demonstrated responsibility for delivering automated equipment.
* Substantial hands-on experience developing and commissioning Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 applications. Your experience includes implementing machine functionality and bringing it into operation.
* Strong Structured Text programming skills and experience organizing software into reusable function blocks and clear interfaces.
* Practical experience configuring and troubleshooting EtherCAT networks, I/O, and servo systems.
* Experience implementing motion control, commissioning axes, tuning drives, and diagnosing motion performance.
* Ability to read electrical schematics and troubleshoot interactions between software and physical equipment.
* Clear communication, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to follow technical issues through resolution.
* Willingness to travel for installation and commissioning.

Experience that would strengthen your application
  

* TwinCAT NC PTP, NC I, or CNC applications involving coordinated motion and interpolated toolpaths.
* Robotics, custom kinematics, coordinate transformations, or path-controlled manufacturing.
* TwinSAFE programming and machine safety validation.
* TwinCAT HMI or other industrial operator-interface development.
* ADS communication and integration with C#, C++, Python, or web applications.
* Git, object-oriented programming, automated testing, and reusable software-library development.
* Simulation, virtual commissioning, or digital machine models.
* Precision manufacturing, process instrumentation, force control, or closed-loop process control.
* Experience with Siemens, B&R, or Rockwell platforms.
* AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or similar electrical design tools.

You do not need experience with every preferred technology to apply. We are especially interested in engineers who combine strong Beckhoff fundamentals with curiosity, practical troubleshooting skills, and ownership of completed machines.
  
  
You’ve learned about what you'll be doing, here are the benefits you'll gain when you join our team:
  

* Global team recognized for their passion of inventing
* First-of-a-kind product culture and project exposure
* Training and development from industry-leading experts
* Cutting edge benefit programs that include: 401(k) & matching; Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance; Disability & Life Insurance; PTO, Paid Holidays, & Parental Leave for both Parents; Tuition Reimbursement

PAR Systems is an equal opportunity employer and we value individuals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin or any other status protected by applicable law. We use AI to assist with sorting applications, but real humans do all the evaluating and deciding. We offer market competitive pay and benefits based upon the candidate’s skills, experience, qualifications, and internal equity. jobs.title: Circa - Facilities - Junior Electrical Engineer Manager
jobs.description:
Circa Resort & Casino
  
  
**JOB TITLE:** JUNIOR ELECTRICAL ENGINEER MANAGER
  
**DEPARTMENT:** FACILITIES
  
**STATUS:** FULL TIME
  
**REPORTS TO:** DIRECTOR OF FACILITIES
  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
Owns all lighting and lighting controls property-wide, interior, exterior, architectural, and feature, plus the Guest Room Management System (GRMS) and supporting low-voltage infrastructure. Hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and programming, with support to Facilities on daily operations and emergency calls.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**  
**Lighting:** Interior & Exterior
  

* Troubleshoot and repair all lighting properties wide: casino floor, guest rooms and corridors, F&B, event space, retail, pool, and back-of-house.
* Own exterior and site lighting, façade and feature, porte-cochère, garage and lots, signage and marquee, landscape, and egress/emergency.
* Replace lamps, drivers, ballasts, and LED modules, diagnose flicker, color shift, and dimming faults to root cause.
* Trace and repair branch circuits, contactors, relays, and lighting panels, maintain fixture inventory and spec standards.

Lighting Controls & Programming
  

* Program and commission scenes, zones, schedules, presets, and override behavior.
* Maintain astronomical time clocks, photocells, occupancy sensors, and daylight controls, adjust seasonally, when needed.
* Support events, features, and holiday lighting, keep configuration backups and version records current.

Guest Room Management System (GRMS)
  

* Troubleshoot room controllers, sensors, thermostats, logic, control panels, drapery motors, and room scenes.
* Program, configure and commission rooms, device swap, or firmware update, validate scenes and setback before release to inventory.
* Respond to guest room calls quickly and discreetly, track and eliminate repeat failures.

Low Voltage
  

* Install, terminate, test, and repair low-voltage cabling and devices for lighting control, GRMS, and building controls.
* Maintain control networks, addressing, gateways, controller comms, diagnose comm loss and bus faults.
* Keep as-builts, riser diagrams, device schedules, and labeling current.

Facility Support, Documentation & Safety
  

* Support daily Facilities work orders, PMs, and guest impacting calls outside primary scope as assigned.
* Respond to after hours and emergency calls, power loss, panel trips, life safety lighting failures.
* Support event turnovers, contractor escort and inspection, and shutdown/restoration under senior engineering direction.
* Document all work in the CMMS, maintain panel schedules and as-builts, support egress and emergency lighting testing records.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**  
Required
  

* BS/BE in Electrical Engineering or EET.
* 0–3 years in electrical systems, building controls, or lighting. Internship, apprenticeship, or military experience counts.
* Working knowledge of the NEC, able to read electrical drawings, one lines, panel schedules, and control submittals.
* Hands on troubleshooting.
* Basic networking literacy.

Preferred
  

* EIT or passed FE exam.
* GRMS experience in hospitality.
* Programming or commissioning on a lighting control platform.
* Experience in a hotel, casino, resort, or other 24/7 environment.

**DISCLAIMER:**  
This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements efforts or working conditions associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the current job or to require that other or different tasks be performed when circumstances change (e.g. emergencies, changes in personnel, workload, rush jobs or technical developments).

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Team Lead - Perception Platforms
jobs.description:
**Mission Summary:**

On our Perception team, you have the opportunity to work with world-class ML engineers and research scientists to make self-driving vehicles a reality. The Perception Platform team is central to this mission, operating at the intersection of ML Infrastructure and Perception. We build the foundational frameworks, evaluation pipelines, and tooling that enable our Perception team to scale their work on the tech stack responsible for perceiving the dynamic world around our robo-taxi.

These foundational systems include our large-scale data pipelines, which are critical for efficient end-to-end ML development (e.g. data transformation, model training, and model evaluation) of our on-car and off-car Perception solutions. It also includes our evaluation and visualization tools, which provide intuitive insights into dataset distributions, model behavior, system performance, and edge-case scenarios. Finally, our active learning loop which continuously selects and incorporates high-value data to improve model accuracy and robustness over time.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Build, lead and manage a high-performing team in the creation, maintenance, and optimization of our internal data, training, and evaluation pipelines specific to perception modelling team.
* Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and career development opportunities to team members
* Define team goals, priorities, and roadmap in alignment with company objectives
* Work closely with ML engineers to proactively identify and resolve technical challenges , while also contributing directly to the implementation of those improvements. This includes troubleshooting and optimizing machine learning workflows for maximum efficiency and performance, architecting and executing cutting-edge technologies/methodologies for accelerating ML development end-to-end from concept to deployment & maintenance.
* Lead design and code reviews, setting a high bar for quality and ensuring the adoption of best practices.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration ensuring alignment with broader organizational goals.
  

**What We're Looking for:**

* 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in a formal or informal leadership or mentorship role.
* 2+ years of experience developing, operating, or supporting distributed machine learning training across clusters of GPU nodes.
* BS or MS in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* A passion for remaining hands-on and a proven ability to contribute high-quality, production-level code to a shared codebase.
* Fluency in Python and familiarity with data processing libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas)
* Proven experience in backend development and leading the architecture of complex systems.
* A deep understanding of ML or Perception topics to strategically guide pipelines/tooling.
* Demonstrated experience in designing and delivering data visualization tools or internal engineering dashboards that drive insights and action.
* Expert knowledge of software engineering principles, with a track record of leading teams in software design, source control management, build processes, code reviews, and testing methods.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate a technical vision and motivate a team
  

**Bonus Points:**

* Expertise in concurrency, parallel processing, and database systems to inform architectural decisions.
* Experience with distributed computing frameworks like K8s and Ray.
* A proven track record of developing and deploying Perception systems for autonomous vehicles or robotics.
* A Ph.D. in a relevant field, or equivalent industry experience that demonstrates a commitment to continuous learning.
* Proficiency in modern C++ (C++14/17 or later)
* Experience with building products with current LLMs and MCP protocols.
* Experience with GPU-accelerated data processing.
* Familiarity with Pytorch, TensorFlow or other modern ML development platform
* Experience in project management and a history of successfully delivering complex technical projects.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
At Skip-Line, your next circuit will hit the highway.

**Smart sensors. Embedded systems. Machines that move. An industry ready for its next big leap.** If that sounds more exciting than designing another gadget destined for a drawer, keep reading.

At Skip-Line, we build the brains behind modern pavement marking equipment. Our electronic controls, sensors, and embedded software turn paint trucks into autonomous precision machines that mark highways, roads, and runways smarter, with less waste and better data.

We’re the leading technology company in an industry most people drive past without thinking about. Look closer: there’s real-time control, laser sensing, connected hardware, and a whole lot of engineering between “put paint on pavement” and “get it right at speed.” And we’re hiring a collaborative, passionate, Electrical Engineer to help build what’s next.

**Job Location:** Adams Center, NY\* *(see details below)*

* *Must reside in Northern or Central New York regions with the ability to commute to our office on a hybrid schedule.*

**Base Salary:** $78,000 - $135,000, based on experience and demonstrated capabilities.

**What You’ll Do:**

You’ll design, build, and test (or sometimes break on purpose) the electronics behind our next generation of hardware. You’ll work side by side with our embedded, product, and production teams. Here’s what that involves:

* **Design the electronics behind smart machines:** You’ll design and build circuits, boards, and electrical interfaces for controllers, sensors, and connected pavement marking systems.
* **Board bring-up:** You’ll bring new boards to life by building prototypes, doing board bring-up, and troubleshooting with the persistence the problem requires.
* **Lead compliance testing:** You’ll plan and prepare for compliance testing, map out what our products need to pass, prep hardware for EMC/EMI testing, collaborate with outside test labs, and keep at it until we pass.
* **Make hardware and software play nicely:** You’ll collaborate with embedded engineers to investigate system behavior and solve problems across the hardware/firmware seam.
* **Make the call.** You’ll evaluate compliance requirements, recommend practical priorities, and explain the tradeoffs between design changes, testing, cost, and ship dates; know when to make a decision independently and when to bring in the right expertise.
* **Make the next build better.** You’ll partner with production teams on testability, component choices, and troubleshooting, so every new board is easier to make, test, and fix.

**A great design earns its place on the truck.** Through compliance testing, you’ll help build equipment crews can trust and products ready for market.

**What You Bring:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* Hands-on PCB design and board bring-up experience.
* Compliance testing: Hands-on EMC/EMI experience, including prepping products for testing, working with outside labs, and turning failed results into design fixes is a must-have.
* Working knowledge of microcontrollers, sensors, and communication protocols like CAN.
* Comfort reading schematics, working with electronic components, and using tools such as oscilloscopes and multimeters.
* A methodical debugging habit: gather evidence, isolate the cause, fix it, and verify the fix.
* Ownership, sound judgment, and clear communication.

**Big plus:** Real EMC/EMI compliance experience. You’ve been to the test lab, failed a scan and figured out why.

**Never been near a paint truck? No problem. Bring your engineering curiosity. We’ll introduce you to the trucks.**

**Why Skip-Line?**

* **Real technology. Visible impact.** Our lineup spans precision striping controls, cloud-connected data logging, and laser-based material monitoring. Your work helps crews do a difficult job better.
* **A tight team where your ideas ship.** You won’t be a cog. You’ll decide what technology goes on paint trucks, challenge assumptions, and help shape better products with an innovative, collaborative team.
* **Modern tools, real judgment.** Use AI and modern tooling freely. Just understand the circuit and own the result.
* **Benefits that support life beyond the bench.** Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) retirement with company match; paid vacation and sick time; and a paid week off at Christmas, and more.
* **Established leadership. Continuous Innovation.** We’ve been advancing pavement-marking technology since 1969. We’re not done inventing.

**Build something worth putting on the road.**

Send your resume to **hr@skipline.com** with **“Electrical Engineer — Skip-Line”** in the subject line.

**Want to stand out?** Include a few sentences about a hardware problem you solved: what went wrong, how you found it, and what you changed. A project link is welcome. **Please don’t share confidential work.**

**The road ahead needs better technology. Help us build it.**

*Skip-Line is an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment and consider applicants without regard to protected characteristics under applicable federal, state, and local law.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Agent Builder (Alwin by DataSnipper)
jobs.description:
**About DataSnipper**
---------------------

Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.

Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning it does not just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.

We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** in our **New York** office to join the **Agent Builder** team behind **Alwin**, our Agentic Automation Platform for audit and finance. Alwin agents run multi-step audit procedures over client evidence and return finished workpapers with every number traced back to source. Humans plan, review and sign off.

Agent Builder is where firms encode their methodology into agents. Methodology and quality teams describe how a procedure should execute; you build the product that turns that into a governed, versioned agent their whole firm can run consistently, every time. The problems are largely open: there is no playbook for letting auditors author production agents in a regulated domain, so you will help write it.

This is a hands-on role in a team that moves fast and holds a high bar. Your work goes in front of hundreds of thousands of audit and finance professionals at the world's largest firms.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

### **Agent Authoring**

* Build the authoring experience that encodes a firm's audit methodology into a configurable, multi-step agent
* Design the agent definition model: steps, tools, inputs, thresholds, planning behaviour and human-in-the-loop gates
* Choose the right abstraction for builders, so non-engineers get consistent agents without writing prompts from scratch
* Work with the Agent Runtime team so authored agents compile cleanly onto the base agent, tools and orchestration layer

### **Governance & Quality**

* Own versioning, publishing and governance in the Agent Library: who may build, publish and run which agent
* Give builders a way to test and evaluate an agent before publishing, working with the Agent Runtime and Evals teams
* Instrument authored agents in production and use traces (**Grafana**, **OpenTelemetry**, **MLflow**) to find where definitions break down
* Implement security, access-control and audit-trail requirements expected by regulated customers, aligned with **OWASP GenAI**

### **Collaboration & Impact**

* Own features end-to-end in our **Python** stack (**FastAPI**, **Pydantic**, **MongoDB**) on **Azure**, through to the **React** web app
* Architect services with clear contracts that other Alwin teams can build on
* Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, mentorship and well-documented technical decisions
* Break down epics and manage ambiguity with product, design and audit methodology experts

**What You Will Bring**
-----------------------

### **Must-Have**

* **6+ years** in software engineering, with strong, production-grade **Python**
* Hands-on experience **building and operating agentic systems in production**: control loops, tool calling, planning versus execution, retries and fallbacks, not only prompt-and-parse pipelines
* Experience with **LLM APIs and agent frameworks** across more than one model provider
* Solid experience building **data-driven web APIs** on a major **cloud platform**
* Strong fundamentals in **software architecture**, **system design** and **data modelling**

**Systems Software Engineer, Hardware Validation**

**About us:**

Voyant Photonics builds silicon photonic chips that steer and switch light at high speed. They power next generation, chip-scale FMCW LiDAR for robotics and autonomy, and optical circuit switches (OCS) for AI data centers. Based in NYC, we’re a hands-on team designing, building, and deploying frontier hardware to solve problems that matter, from how machines see to how AI scales.

**About the role**

Our tech stack spans FPGA and ASIC logic, microcontroller firmware, Linux drivers and cross platform user-facing APIs, and every layer changes every week. We're hiring engineers, at more than one level, to keep them integrated, tested and releasable.

**What Actually Matters**

Code is cheaper to write than ever. Knowing what should be written, and what "done" means, is the job. We want someone with strong, well-reasoned opinions about how software should be organized and how test coverage should grow, who argues for them, and who changes their mind when the evidence says so.

Things we believe in as a team:

* **Fix it at the source.** A bug gets fixed where it lives, even when that's someone else's code. The friction of working in each other's areas is worth it.
* **Live at the tip.** Every repo tracks the latest of everything it depends on. Small, frequent bumps surface breaks while they're still cheap to fix.
* **Duplicated code is broken code.** Two copies drift apart, and then one of them is wrong.
* **It doesn't work until someone else has run it on hardware.** Your own simulation or bench is where you start, not where you're done.

Disagree with one? Tell us why when you apply.

**What You'll Do**

* Own releases from commit to customer: build, verify, version and ship product bundles (FPGA bitstreams, firmware, drivers, APIs), including field updates, with release notes and runbooks people trust.
* Grow our HIL CI to cover every subsystem, and bring each new product into it from its first bring-up board.
* Track every bug CI finds to its root cause, whether that's Python, Rust, firmware, a Linux driver or FPGA logic, then fix it.
* Take our products into the systems that use them: time sync, calibration, sensor fusion, and open-source ecosystems like OCP and ROS.

**What We're Looking For**

* 2+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent depth from research, internships or serious personal projects. We'll scale scope to experience.
* Strong Python, and comfort debugging languages you don't write every day.
* Hands-on hardware experience: bring-up, reading schematics, and using lab instruments to tell a software bug from a board bug.
* CI/CD experience, ideally against real hardware.
* Proactive communicator who cares about documentation to support cross functional team members & customers.

**Nice to Have**

* Rust, C++ or embedded C (we use STM32)
* Linux device drivers, especially SPI and custom low-level interfaces
* Reading System Verilog well enough to debug across the FPGA boundary
* HIL rigs and lab automation (SCPI/VISA, self-hosted CI runners)
* Timing and signal-integrity debug across SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet and JTAG/SWD, plus board rework
* Fiber optics and optical test equipment
* Datacenter networking, PTP, point clouds or ROS 2
* Supporting software that external customers depend on

**What You'll Gain**

* Ownership of the release and test architecture for our products, from first bring-up to shipping: real decisions, not someone else's pipeline.
* Close collaboration with hardware, optics, signal processing and perception engineers, and real influence over technical direction at an early-stage company.
* A path toward customer-facing integration work, if that interests you.

**Life at Voyant**

We build frontier hardware & software from our lab and office in Midtown Manhattan, where optical tables, lab benches and electronics sit alongside traditional office space. Our work is hands-on and primarily in person, but we don’t run on a rigid 9-to-5. We partner with customers across time zones, so some calls start early or run late, and we adjust schedules around them. We run a high-trust, high-accountability environment: you’ll own meaningful work, move quickly and often wear more than one hat.
