**Embedded Firmware Engineer, Hardware Bring-up & Controls**

**About us:**

Voyant Photonics builds silicon photonic chips that steer and switch light at high speed. They power next generation, chip-scale FMCW LiDAR for robotics and autonomy, and optical circuit switches (OCS) for AI data centers. Based in NYC, we’re a hands-on team designing, building, and deploying frontier hardware to solve problems that matter, from how machines see to how AI scales.

**The Role:**

We're hiring an embedded software engineer to bring up our new boards quickly and own the drivers and control firmware that run on them.

You care how an algorithm is implemented in firmware, but you're just as comfortable with the schematic open, a probe on the board and the soldering iron warm. About half your time goes to board bring-up, changing the firmware and the board together until everything comes up; the other half goes to implementing control loops and proving they work on hardware.

We are a collaborative, close knit team who love to solve complex problems and building robust systems. If you enjoy the challenge of working with frontier hardware, bringing up both brand new boards and cutting-edge control loops, we are excited to talk to you.

**Your impact:**

Code is cheaper to write than ever. Knowing what should be written, and what "done" means, is the job. A board is done when it works, not when the firmware compiles; a loop is done when it meets its requirements on hardware, not when the simulation looks good. We want someone with strong, well-reasoned opinions about how control algorithms and drivers should be implemented in firmware, and how to prove they work, who argues for them, and who changes their mind when the evidence says so.

A few strong opinions the team holds:

* **Fix it at the source.** A bug gets fixed where it lives, even when that's someone else's code. The friction of working in each other's areas is worth it.
* **Live at the tip.** Every repo tracks the latest of everything it depends on. Small, frequent bumps surface breaks while they're still cheap to fix.
* **Duplicated code is broken code.** Two copies drift apart, and then one of them is wrong.
* **It doesn't work until someone else has run it on hardware.** Your own simulation or bench is where you start, not where you're done.

Disagree with one? Tell us why when you apply.

**What You'll Do**

* Implement control algorithms in real-time embedded C++: discretization, sample-rate and latency budgets, anti-windup, saturation handling, and numerical robustness in fixed and floating point. Push back with measured data when the plant doesn't match the model.
* Write the drivers and firmware structure each new board needs, and keep them clean enough that the next board reuses them.
* Bring up each new board by changing the firmware and the board together: read the schematic and datasheets, probe signals, debug SPI, I2C, UART and custom chip interfaces, and make small SMT reworks when the board needs one.
* Prove it works: build the test setups and Python analysis that show each driver and loop meets its requirements on hardware, from single PID loops to tuning many switch elements across a large optical network.
* Feed what bring-up finds back to the hardware team so the next board revision comes up faster.

**What We're Looking For**

* BS in computer engineering, computer science or a related field, with 2+ years of embedded software experience in a professional environment.
* C or C++ on microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M, STM32 or similar), bare-metal or RTOS. Our codebase is C++, but strong embedded C engineers are encouraged to apply.
* Working control theory: PID, loop shaping and stability margins, and state-space design, and a feel for what each costs in firmware.
* Board bring-up from the firmware side: schematics, datasheets, scopes and logic analyzers, and small reworks like swapping passives etc.
* Python for test automation and data analysis.

**Nice to Have**

* Measuring plant response and system identification on real hardware
* MIMO and decoupling, observers, PLLs and tracking loops, or online optimization (e.g. extremum seeking) of multi-channel systems
* Lab automation: scripting scopes, supplies and generators (SCPI/VISA)
* Debugging across an FPGA or ASIC boundary
* Thermal, motor/actuator or optical systems

**What You'll Gain**

* Ownership of how our firmware is built and how our boards come up, from first power-on to shipping: real decisions, not someone else's checklist.
* Close collaboration with the whole engineering org including hardware, optics, signal processing and firmware engineers, and real influence over technical direction at an early-stage company.
* Mentorship from leadership who have experience deploying billions of dollars of hardware to customers around the world.
* Equity in an early stage start up

**Life at Voyant**

We build frontier hardware from our lab and office in Midtown Manhattan, where optical tables, lab benches and electronics sit alongside traditional office space. Our work is hands-on and primarily in person, but we don’t run on a rigid 9-to-5. We partner with customers across time zones, so some calls start early or run late, and we adjust schedules around them. We run a high-trust, high-accountability environment: you’ll own meaningful work, move quickly and often wear more than one hat. Voyant provides catered lunch every day at HQ, and we’re a diverse group of food lovers from around the world who enjoy sharing food, culture and technical ideas around the lunch table.

* What's something you built just because you wanted to?

* **Security & Compliance:** Developing the mechanisms for setting, managing, and enforcing security policies across all devices and applications, ensuring employee and corporate data remain protected.

==============================================

The Senior Mainframe Platform Engineer is responsible for the engineering, health, security, resiliency, connectivity, and performance of mission-critical mainframe platforms. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Seven or more years of professional experience in z/OS or mainframe systems engineering.

  + MQ for z/OS
  + zCEE for z/OS
  + Mainframe networking

  + Storage or hardware configuration

* Experience diagnosing, debugging, tuning, and resolving complex mainframe platform issues.
* Experience supporting production systems through formal change-management and incident-management processes.
* Experience creating detailed technical documentation, procedures, standards, and implementation plans.Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information to engineers, application teams, vendors, management, and executive stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple assignments and meet committed delivery dates.

Our mission is to drive the future of national security by engineering scalable solutions that fuse technological innovation with human potential to transform how individuals and teams train, develop, and perform in mission-critical environments.?

Our culture is rooted in our core values, which have evolved over time and our employees have embraced: **Integrity, Ingenuity, Excellence, Respect, Engagement, Teamwork**. **How You Will Make an Impact**

* As a **Systems Engineer** supporting simulation-based training system integration, you will help advance Aptima’s mission by assisting in the development and sustainment of technical solutions within a government-owned modeling and simulation (M&S) environment. You will work alongside experienced engineers to install, configure, and test systems that enable immersive training and mission rehearsal.
* You will gain hands-on experience by supporting prototyping, integration, and troubleshooting activities across a diverse M&S ecosystem. Whether helping connect simulators to a distributed simulation environment, supporting technical evaluations, or preparing systems for training events, your work will directly contribute to operator training and readiness.
* This role is ideal for early-career engineers eager to grow their technical skills, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and work with cutting-edge simulation technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist with installing, configuring, and maintaining simulation system stacks according to current technical baselines.
* Help integrate simulators and tools using common networking standards and protocols such as GRID or DIS.

* Help maintain simulator readiness by following established system configurations and documenting updates or changes.
* Work with mission partners to support demonstrations, dry runs, and training events.

* 0–2 years of experience in modeling & simulation, software engineering, computer systems, networking, or related technical fields (internships or coursework welcome).
* Basic understanding of networking concepts and protocols.
* Familiarity with Windows and/or Linux operating systems.
* Interest in learning simulation frameworks and M&S integration tools.
* Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to ask questions and learn on the job.
* Good documentation habits and attention to detail.

On our Perception team, you have the opportunity to work with world-class ML engineers and research scientists to make self-driving vehicles a reality. These foundational systems include our large-scale data pipelines, which are critical for efficient end-to-end ML development (e.g. data transformation, model training, and model evaluation) of our on-car and off-car Perception solutions. It also includes our evaluation and visualization tools, which provide intuitive insights into dataset distributions, model behavior, system performance, and edge-case scenarios. Finally, our active learning loop which continuously selects and incorporates high-value data to improve model accuracy and robustness over time.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Description:

**PURPOSE:**

The Automation Engineer is responsible for developing, implementing, maintaining, and improving automated manufacturing systems and processes supporting new and existing products. This role focuses on integrating automation, robotics, controls, and advanced manufacturing technologies to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance.

The position supports new product introduction, production sustainment, and continuous improvement initiatives by identifying automation opportunities, developing technical solutions, troubleshooting equipment and process issues, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. The Automation Engineer works under established technical direction to implement reliable, efficient, and scalable automation solutions aligned with manufacturing objectives.

**DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**1. Automation Development and Integration**

* Support the design, development, and implementation of automated manufacturing systems and equipment.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve manufacturing efficiency, consistency, and repeatability.
* Assist in the integration of robotics, PLCs, sensors, machine vision, motion control, and other automation technologies.
* Support the development of equipment concepts, functional requirements, specifications, and system layouts.
* Collaborate with manufacturing and design engineering to incorporate Design for Automation (DFA) and Design for Manufacturability (DFM) principles into new products and processes.
* Support the evaluation of emerging automation technologies and their potential manufacturing applications.

**2. Equipment Installation, Commissioning, and Qualification**

* Support equipment installation, startup, commissioning, and acceptance activities.
* Assist in developing and executing equipment testing, process validation, and qualification plans.
* Verify automated equipment performance against established specifications, safety requirements, and production objectives.
* Coordinate with equipment suppliers, system integrators, and internal technical teams to resolve installation and performance issues.
* Support equipment acceptance testing and the transition of automated systems into production.
* Develop and maintain equipment operating parameters, recipes, and control settings as applicable.

**3. Production Support and Troubleshooting**

* Provide technical support for automated manufacturing equipment and production processes.
* Troubleshoot automation, controls, sensors, robotics, and equipment-related issues to minimize downtime and production interruptions.
* Identify root causes of recurring equipment failures and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Collaborate with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, and Engineering to improve equipment reliability and process performance.
* Support the development of preventive maintenance requirements and troubleshooting procedures.
* Assist in monitoring equipment performance, cycle time, uptime, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

**4. Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and implement automation and process improvements that enhance safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance.
* Support Lean Manufacturing initiatives, including waste reduction, standardized work, cycle-time improvement, and production flow optimization.
* Analyze manufacturing data to identify trends, process constraints, and opportunities for improvement.
* Participate in root cause analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement activities.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of implemented automation solutions and recommend further improvements.
* Support efforts to reduce scrap, rework, labor content, and process variability.

**5. Project Execution and Supplier Coordination**

* Execute assigned automation projects in accordance with established scope, schedule, budget, and technical requirements.
* Assist in preparing equipment specifications, project schedules, cost estimates, and capital expenditure justifications.
* Coordinate with vendors and system integrators to evaluate technical proposals and support equipment selection.
* Track project activities, resolve technical issues, and communicate project status, risks, and resource needs to stakeholders.
* Support equipment procurement, factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, and project closeout.
* Identify opportunities to reuse proven automation designs and standard components across manufacturing processes.

**6. Documentation and Standardization**

* Develop and maintain automation documentation, including equipment specifications, electrical schematics, control narratives, operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
* Support the development and maintenance of PLC programs, HMI configurations, robot programs, and related technical files in accordance with company standards.
* Maintain appropriate revision control, backups, and documentation for automation systems.
* Establish and follow standard practices for equipment installation, operation, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
* Support the development of standardized automation platforms, components, and control practices under the direction of senior technical personnel.
* Ensure documentation supports safe operation, repeatable processes, and effective knowledge transfer.

**7. Safety, Quality, and Compliance**

* Incorporate appropriate machine safety, guarding, interlocking, and risk-reduction measures into automation projects.
* Support machine risk assessments and compliance with applicable OSHA requirements, recognized industrial safety standards, and company procedures.
* Collaborate with Quality Engineering to ensure automated processes meet product specifications and quality requirements.
* Support process capability studies, equipment qualification, and corrective action activities as required.
* Ensure automation changes are appropriately reviewed, documented

jobs.title: RF Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

  

Join us to design and deploy next-generation, satellite-based radar that delivers persistent, all-weather, day-night sensing at global scale. You’ll build end-to-end capabilities—from waveform design, on-board processing, classification and calibration—for systems on LEO platforms. Working across RF hardware, phased arrays, and advanced DSP, you’ll turn raw echoes into decision-ready products. If you thrive at the intersection of electromagnetics, signal processing, and systems engineering—and want your code and designs to fly—this role is for you.

### **What you’ll be doing:**

* Develop RF requirements and budgets for gain, noise, dynamic range, linearity, phase, timing, spurious response, and interference.

* Model and analyze antenna-to-digitizer and transmit/receive signal-chain performance.

* Define calibration, monitoring, built-in test, and fault-isolation approaches.

* Coordinate with array hardware, FPGA, embedded, signal processing, mechanical, power, thermal, and test teams.

* Support component selection, supplier reviews, lab characterization, design reviews, and anomaly resolution.

### **What you bring to this role:**

* Bachelor's or advanced degree in electrical engineering and 6+ years of RF/microwave system engineering.

* Experience with RF budgets, phased arrays, receivers/transmitters, converters, calibration, and laboratory measurements.

* Proficiency with RF simulation and test tools.

* Ability to translate system performance into component and interface requirements.

* Security clearance: U.S. citizenship is required. Candidate must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance at the Secret level or higher, and any program-specific access required for the position. Continued employment is contingent upon obtaining and maintaining the required clearance and access.

### **Bonus points for the following:**

* UHF radar and high-dynamic-range direct-sampling experience.

* EMI/EMC, interference mitigation, spectrum certification, or environmental qualification experience.

* Experience with large channel-count systems.

This is a full time, exempt position, based out of our Saratoga office. The target base pay for this position is $120,000 - $200,000 annually. The total compensation packaged will be determined by various factors such as your relevant job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used—so we’re looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience on LEO satellite component development, design and in-orbit activities. If that’s your experience – then we’ll be immediately wow-ed.

This role requires access to controlled technical data. Under U.S. law (ITAR/EAR), we can only consider U.S. persons (U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, and individuals granted asylum or refugee status).

E-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role.

**Why E-Space is right for you:**

As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in driving our success. Our team members have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility; this includes a strong commitment to our mission to create an entirely new suite of global capabilities to improve lives, business efficiencies and build a smarter planet. This means that there will be times when extra hours, including nights and weekends, may be needed to meet critical deadlines and mission goals. In return, we offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development and the chance to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth industry.

  

We want you to make the most of your journey at E-Space. That’s why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E-Space:

* An opportunity to really make a difference

jobs.title: Senior Security Software Engineer, Datacenter Infrastructure Security
jobs.description:
We are the Foundational Security team in Apple Services Engineering (ASE). We secure the low-level foundations of Apple's datacenter fleet: hardware-backed trust, disk encryption, and the systems used to manage every server below the operating system.  
  
We're looking for a senior engineer to take technical ownership of the platform that manages our baseboard management controllers. You'll set its engineering and security bar, shape how access is granted and verified, and lead its move toward modern, standards-based management. You'll work closely with datacenter operations, SRE, hardware, network and detection teams, and become the go-to expert on managing Apple's fleet securely.  
  
**Description**  
  
This role owns the design, code and security of a privileged, availability-critical service. You'll write and review production code. You'll find and remove risk in how the service authenticates users, authorizes them and handles credentials, and you'll make privileged activity visible to the teams who detect misuse. You'll also help modernize how the fleet is managed, bringing along the many internal teams and tools that depend on the platform.  
  
Over time, you'll help define what secure out-of-band management looks like at Apple. That includes how access is segmented across environments, how firmware is delivered and trusted, and what we require of management controllers in future hardware. It also includes how access should work when the requester is an automated system rather than a person.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Hands-on experience with server management technologies such as IPMI, DMTF Redfish, OpenBMC, or vendor BMCs (e.g., HPE iLO, Dell iDRAC)  
  
Experience finding and fixing security flaws in networked services through code review, threat modeling or security testing  
  
A track record of technical leadership: driving architecture decisions and cross-team migrations, mentoring engineers, and explaining security trade-offs to engineers and leadership  
  
Experience with gRPC and Protocol Buffers, and with running PostgreSQL in production  
  
Experience managing the lifecycle of secrets and credentials at fleet scale, including rotation and emergency access  
  
Experience building and operating highly available, distributed services that other teams depend on  
  
Familiarity with network segmentation and zero-trust access patterns, such as identity-aware proxies  
  
Knowledge of firmware security, including secure boot, firmware signing and updates, TPMs and hardware roots of trust  
  
Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants on a production codebase  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
8+ years of software engineering experience, including end-to-end ownership of a production system or platform  
  
Deep proficiency in Go, with 5+ years writing production Go code.  
  
Experience building security telemetry for SIEM and detection pipelines (e.g., Splunk, OpenTelemetry)  
  
Hands-on experience with authentication and authorization at scale, including PKI, mTLS, X.509 certificate identity and fine-grained access control  
  
Experience with Swift, and Rust  
  
BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Staff Controls Engineer, Optimus
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla's Optimus program is building a future of sustainable abundance and we are building a team that designs and builds the automated manufacturing machines. You'll be at the center of one of the most ambitious manufacturing launches in Tesla's history, and likely the world’s, driving rapid equipment development and deployment on the Optimus production line.

As a Staff Controls Engineer, your primary responsibility is to be the lead controls engineer for new, automated manufacturing equipment projects. You’ll be involved in projects from start to finish, where you’ll oversee and provide guidance for junior engineers assigned to the project and provide direct technical contributions for the most critical areas of the project. You and your team will architect, develop and deploy software for industrial controllers, like PLCs, HMIs, robot controllers, machine vision systems and more. New automated manufacturing equipment is designed, built and performance tested by us, then set up at its final destination for final commissioning and start of production.

 **What You'll Do**

* Take the lead controls engineering role, leading a team of controls engineers to complete capex projects on accelerated timelines
* Design high performing equipment by collaborating with mechanical & electrical engineers on topics such as machine layout, tooling design, process strategies and hardware selection of motors & drives, actuators, and sensors
* Challenge requirements & assumptions, identify & delete unnecessary parts & processes and find ways to reduce complexity

* Accelerate your team toward success by providing consistent leadership throughout all phases of the project. You’ll set aggressive goals for them, review their progress, support them technically and professionally and make necessary course corrections along the way

* Work hands-on with the equipment during the debug phase to bring it to a high performing and robust state by performing validations and exception testing for hardware, software, and processes
* Travel to the factory for on-site commissioning of the equipment, performing final validations, and supporting it into production. Ability to travel up to 25%, potentially on short notice

  
**What You'll Bring**

* 8+ years’ experience programming, debugging, and commissioning industrial machines of moderate to high complexity
* Experience programming PLCs from brands like Siemens, Allen Bradley, or Beckhoff. Siemens PLC programming experience is preferred
* Strong mechanical aptitude and proficiency with hand tools

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton provides management and technical support for NASA’s scientific balloon program which supports enabling science missions for NASA and universities across the United States and foreign scientific communities. Scientific balloon missions provide researchers inexpensive, relatively quick, long duration access to near space altitudes and environments. Balloon missions cost orders of magnitude less than satellite missions and provide platforms for heavy experiments (some greater than 5000-lbs) to operate for weeks and even months. Balloon missions have provided significant science theories and discoveries about cosmic rays, gamma ray and x-ray astronomy, optical and UV astronomy, atmospheric sciences, and cosmic microwave background studies.

  

Our staff are located at the Columbia Scientific Balloon Facility (CSBF) in Palestine, TX where we design, analyze, build and assembly the support hardware and balloon gondola payloads for the missions. We launch the balloons from locations within the United States (Texas, New Mexico, and Hawaii) and around the world including Antarctica, Sweden, New Zealand, and Australia. Our engineers and technician staff support the launches and balloon and payload recoveries in the US and many worldwide locations. Peraton’s NASA Balloon Operations Contract (NBOC) program is seeking a candidate to support manufacture, test, integration, and field operations for NASA Balloon missions.

  

Our rural campus offers the ability to work in a low-cost of living area, but within an easy drive of Tyler, Dallas and Houston.

jobs.description:
***Please Note:*** *To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.*

At **CesiumAstro**, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are seeking a **Staff Power Electronics Engineer**to join our growing *spacecraft payload development**team*. In this position, you will contribute across the entire development lifecycle of next-generation power electronics hardware for satellites and space power systems payloads—from leading the definition of power system architectures and trade studies to detailed circuit design, simulation, printed circuit board (PCB) layout, verification and integration testing, production transition, and manufacturing support.

### **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define electrical power system architecture, and derive power subsystem requirements

* Design DC-DC power converters, motor drives, inverters, power management and control circuits from concept to production release

* Perform detailed design for low to high complexity analog and power electronics circuits ranging from single DC-DC power converters to multi-output power supply modules

* Perform modeling and analysis of analog and power electronics designs including worst-case circuit analysis (WCA), stress analysis, small signal modeling analysis, failure modes and effects analysis (FMEA), reliability analysis, and power integrity analysis

* Develop design verification test plans, requirement compliance matrices, system integration and qualification test plans, and production acceptance test plans for power converters and power supply designs

* Lead board bring-up and design verification testing of power electronics circuits and modules

* Lead system integration, qualification campaigns, and release of analog and power electronics designs into production

* Mentor younger engineers and foster knowledge sharing

* Lead a small team of power electronics engineers to drive project execution

* Perform research and monitor power electronics industry trends to drive innovation and generate intellectual property in this area

### **REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor of Science (BS) degree or higher in Electrical Engineering (or related) from an accredited university.

* Minimum of 9 years of experience designing analog and power electronics

* Experience working with electrical power systems and subsystems, including developing power architecture and power requirements, performing trade studies for size, weight, power, and cost optimization (SWAP-C), selecting power converter topologies, and defining power management and control blocks

* Experience with modeling and control of DC-DC converters and power stage design of different isolated and non-isolated DC-DC power converters (e.g. discrete linear regulators, Buck, Boost, Buck-boost, Flyback, Forward, Half-bridge, Full bridge, and Resonant converters)

* Experience designing custom signal and power magnetics, and power filters for low noise and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC)

* Experience developing design verification test plans, requirement compliance matrices, system integration and qualification test plans, and production acceptance test plans

* Experience performing worst-case circuit analysis (WCA), stress analysis, failure modes and effects analysis (FMEA), and reliability analysis for power supplies

* Extensive hands-on experience with testing and troubleshooting electronics and power converters using laboratory instruments such as oscilloscopes, impedance analyzers, spectrum analyzers, electronic loads, and signal generators

* Experience with electronics schematic capture and printed circuit board (PCB) layout tools such as Altium, OrCAD, Allegro or Xpedition

* Experience with analysis and simulation tools such as SPICE, LTSPICE, SIMetrix/SIMPLIS, PLECS, Simulink, MATLAB, MathCAD, ANSYS Q3D and SiWave, or HyperLynx

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

### **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* Master of Science or PhD in Electrical Engineering with research focus in power electronics

* Experience designing high-reliability analog and power electronics for automotive, space or defense applications

* Knowledge of space radiation environments and radiation effects in electronics

* Experience in power electronics applications utilizing GaN or SiC wide bandgap power semiconductor devices

* Experience running board-level power integrity simulation using tools such as Ansys SiWave, or HyperLynx

* Experience with soft switching and resonant power converter topologies (e.g. LLC, CLLC, series resonant, phase shifted full bridge, dual active bridge, etc.)

* Experience with power stage design for inverters and motor drives

* Knowledge of modeling and control of inverters and motor drives

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.
  
  
Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.
  
  
Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
  
  
Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
  
  
Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.
  
  
Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.

Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.

Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
  
  
Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience with Industrial control systems, both hardware and software
* 4+ years of general contractor and vendor management work (request for proposals, bidding, change orders, quality control, RFI/submittal tracking) associated with construction and project execution experience
* 5+ years of experience with industrial controls in critical environment (data center, pharmaceutical, oil & gas, petrochemical, laboratory, power, water etc.).

jobs.description:
Job ID: 2618083

**Location:** Fort Belvoir, VA, US

**Date Posted:** 2026-10-19

**Category:** Engineering and Sciences

**Subcategory:** Systems Engineer

**Schedule:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** Yes - 10% of the time

**Minimum Clearance Required:** TS.SCI

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** TS/SCI with Poly

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_ON\_SITE

**Description**

**﻿SAIC has an immediate need for a Terrestrial Sensor SME to support our team located at Fort Belvoir, Virginia.**

The Terrestrial Sensor SME acts as the US Army Intelligence and Security Command (INSCOM) G7’s primary technical expert, translating complex hardware, software, and physical layer capabilities into strategic requirements, acquisition-ready documentation, and actionable operational integration plans.

**Responsibilities:**

* Be INSCOM G7's primary technical expert on terrestrial sensor programs (e.g., TLS-BCT, TLS-Echelons Above Division) at GO/FO level forums, PM (Program Manager) reviews, and Joint/Army modernization working groups.
* Lead the development, drafting, and staffing of terrestrial sensor requirements documents (CDDs, ICDs) and operational concepts to influence the JCIDS process and future Army acquisitions.
* Synchronize terrestrial sensor integration with INSCOM G3 (Operations), G6 (Communications/IT), and Army Cyber Command to ensure sensor data feeds seamlessly into the wider intelligence architecture.
* Provide feasible and actionable recommendations to INSCOM G7 leadership via white papers, technical assessments, and Army Memos regarding emerging terrestrial sensing technologies, capability gaps, and material solutions.
* Oversee the alignment of terrestrial sensor systems with the Intelligence/SIGINT/Cyber enterprise, ensuring local sensor data is ingestible by advanced analytics platforms and cloud environments.

  

**Qualifications**

**Required Education:**

* Bachelors and nine (9) years or more experience; Masters and seven (7) years or more experience ; PhD or JD and four (4) years or more experience.

**Qualifications**:

* Deep technical knowledge of Army terrestrial sensing platforms, to include Tactical Land Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), Electronic Warfare (EW), Cyberspace, and electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensors.
* Demonstrated experience integrating terrestrial sensors into broader networks and processing systems (e.g., PM EW&C systems, DCGS-A, tactical communications fabrics, and cloud-based data lakes).
* Proven track record navigating the Army Requirements Determination, JCIDS, and Defense Acquisition System pathways specifically for intelligence or electronic sensor payloads.
* Expert understanding of tactical data dissemination, sensor-to-shooter links, and processing/analytics principles that turn raw terrestrial sensor data into combat-ready intelligence.
* Exceptional ability to translate highly complex technical specifications (e.g., frequency ranges, gain, sensor processing limitations) into plain-language mission impacts for senior military leaders.
* Capacity to independently identify capability gaps in current terrestrial fleets, evaluate emerging commercial/defense tech, and formulate mitigation strategies.

**Clearance:**

* Candidate must have an active TS/SCI clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI Poly.

Target salary range: $140,001 - $180,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

**Lead Network Automation Engineer**

  
  

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced **Lead Network Automation Engineer** to lead the development, implementation, and sustainment of network automation solutions supporting a complex, multivendor enterprise network environment.

  
  

The ideal candidate combines strong network engineering fundamentals with advanced hands on expertise in Python and Ansible. This individual will collaborate closely with network administrators, engineers, architects, and customer stakeholders to translate technical requirements into scalable, reliable, and maintainable automation solutions.

This is a hands on technical leadership position responsible for developing production ready automation, mentoring a small team of automation engineers, and helping establish repeatable engineering practices.

  
  

The successful candidate will play a critical role in improving network operational efficiency, accelerating configuration deployments, reducing manual effort, and increasing the consistency and reliability of network infrastructure operations.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  
  

**Network Automation Engineering**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain network automation solutions using Python and Ansible.
* Develop Ansible playbooks, Python scripts, and reusable automation modules to support network configuration management, provisioning, patching, maintenance, and operational tasks.
* Automate network device configuration changes, software updates, configuration backups, compliance checks, and operational validation across multivendor environments.
* Develop automation capabilities supporting Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Aruba, and other enterprise networking technologies.
* Implement automated configuration validation, network state verification, and configuration drift detection to improve network reliability and compliance.
* Build automation solutions for network monitoring, reporting, inventory management, and operational data collection.
* Develop standardized, reusable automation components that reduce repetitive administrative activities and improve engineering consistency.
* Incorporate appropriate error handling, logging, validation, and rollback capabilities into automated network changes.
* Troubleshoot automation failures and resolve integration challenges between automation tools and network infrastructure.

**Engineering Collaboration and Requirements Execution**

* Work directly with network administrators, engineers, and architects to understand technical requirements and operational challenges.
* Translate network engineering specifications into functional automation playbooks, scripts, and workflows.
* Evaluate manual network administration processes and identify opportunities to improve execution through automation.
* Collaborate with infrastructure and cybersecurity teams to ensure automated solutions satisfy operational and security requirements.
* Validate automation solutions with network engineering stakeholders before deployment into production environments.
* Provide technical recommendations regarding implementation approaches, automation feasibility, and operational considerations.

**Technical Leadership and Team Development**

* Serve as the technical lead for a small team of network automation engineers.
* Provide technical direction, mentorship, and hands on support to team members.
* Coordinate and assign automation development activities based on established engineering priorities.
* Conduct code reviews and promote consistent development, testing, documentation, and version control practices.
* Establish reusable development standards and promote knowledge sharing across the automation team.
* Support the development of junior and midlevel engineers through technical coaching and collaborative problem solving.
* Communicate progress, technical challenges, dependencies, and delivery risks to engineering and program leadership.

**Automation Capability Development and Sustainment**

* Enhance existing Python scripts and Ansible playbooks while expanding the organization's automation capabilities.
* Establish consistent approaches for source code management, testing, documentation, and deployment.
* Develop maintainable automation solutions that can be supported and enhanced by other engineers.
* Assist with implementing appropriate development, testing, and production deployment controls.
* Document automation workflows, technical dependencies, operating procedures, and troubleshooting guidance.
* Measure automation effectiveness through improvements in task execution time, configuration consistency, reduction in manual activities, and operational reliability.
  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  
  

**Security and Work Requirements**

* Active TS/SCI security clearance.
* Ability to work onsite in a secure customer environment.

**Technical Qualifications**

* Advanced proficiency developing Python scripts, modules, and applications for network infrastructure automation.
* Advanced hands on experience developing, troubleshooting, and maintaining Ansible playbooks and automation workflows.
* Demonstrated experience automating network configuration deployments, device administration, software patching, or other network operational activities.
* Working knowledge of enterprise routing and switching fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLAN

jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------

**About WSDOT**

The Washington State Department of Transportation (WSDOT) is a multimodal agency with a global reputation for excellence. Our dedicated workforce plans, designs, builds, and operates an integrated transportation system that safely and efficiently moves people and goods throughout the state. In addition to maintaining over 20,000 lane miles of state highway and 4,100 bridges, WSDOT leads an award-winning Active Transportation Plan, manages the world's longest floating bridge, and operates the largest ferry system in the nation!

Washington State Ferries (WSF) is an essential part of Washington's transportation network. Every year, we carry nearly 20 million passengers across Puget Sound and the San Juan Islands on more than 400 sailings a day. Our dedicated teams with over 2,100 people work together to serve our communities and shape the future of ferry travel.

  
  

**The Opportunity**

WSF, a division of WSDOT, is currently seeking an engineering professional with maritime experience to support the electrical systems that keep Washington’s ferry fleet operating safely and reliably. Working under the direction of the Chief Naval Architect, this position contributes to vessel modifications, repairs, and new construction that sustain essential ferry service. Maritime experience is critical to developing designs that address vessel operating conditions and meet applicable marine regulatory and electrical standards. Join a team dedicated to strengthening fleet reliability and serving the communities that depend on Washington State Ferries.

As we navigate a once-in-a-generation transformation to decarbonize our system — guided by our core values Serve, Respect, Trust, Grow Navigate, and bold strategic priorities Service Excellence, Improved Communication and Empowered People — there’s never been a more meaningful time to come aboard at Washington State Ferries.

  

**What to Expect**

Among the varied range of responsibilities held within this role, you/the Electrical Engineer 4 will:

* Apply maritime electrical engineering expertise to design ferry vessel modifications, repairs, and new construction.
* Prepare calculations, specifications, and drawings for vessel power, lighting, communications, and navigation systems, including short-circuit and power analyses.
* Verify vessel-specific compliance with USCG, ABS, IMO/SOLAS, IEEE, and NEC requirements.
* Lead electrical installation design and coordinate engineering support for complex vessel projects.
* Conduct ship checks, verify drawings and calculations, confirm As-Built conditions, and prepare regulatory and stakeholder reports.
* Develop technical and cost information and specifications for equipment, materials, and shipyard installations and removals.
* Review vendor, consultant, contractor, and design work for accuracy and compliance with calculations, specifications, and contract requirements.
* Troubleshoot vessel electrical and electronic systems; provide technical assistance and training to vessel engineering and Eagle Harbor staff.
* Uphold WSF’s strategic priorities (Service Excellence, Improved Communication, and Empowered People) and values (Serve, Grow, Trust, Respect, and Navigate), ensuring they are embedded in WSF’s culture through leadership actions

**Qualifications**

To be considered for this opportunity, the following are required:

* **Service-Oriented –** Demonstrates a willingness to take action to meet the needs of others.
* **Growth Mindset –** Actively demonstrates a commitment to learning and growth.
* Experience contributing to a work environment that fosters a culture of respect and equal opportunity.
* Experience in shipyard or consulting Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering Design Office dealing with shipboard electrical systems.
* Registered as a Professional Engineer in electrical engineering in Washington State, or registration in another state with the ability to obtain Washington State licensure within six months of appointment.
* Ability to apply first-principles engineering methods to perform calculations and technical analyses in support of vessel systems and equipment.
* Ability to critically interpret and verify engineering drawings and technical specifications, and to develop accurate, well-structured reports and documentation in support of vessel equipment modification, correction, and installation.
* Ability to demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to follow complex technical direction and effectively coordinate with team members, contractors, and fleet personnel.
* Experience with the analysis and design of electrical & electronic systems used in marine applications.

It is preferred that qualified candidates also have:

* Experience working in a marine environment. Knowledge of public sector rules and regulations.
* Experience learning and using specialty software such as SKM, Rhino3d, Ship Constructor, etc.
* Ability to understand and apply detailed instructions and scheduling requirements to plan and execute work, manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and perform assignments independently.

  

**Important Notes**

* This position offers flexible/hybrid remote work options.
* The salary listed includes the legislative approved 5% salary premium for positions in King County.
* In addition to base salary, employees may be entitled to other forms of compensation depending on the type, duties, or location of the position. For union-represented positions, more information on other forms of compensation can be found in the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreements. Information on other compensation types for non-represented positions can be found in Chapter 357-28 of the Washington Administrative Code.

The Systems Engineer leads the design and execution of Globe's mechanical equipment solutions while managing and developing a team of engineers. ---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Amazon Web Services is hiring a Product Design Electrical Engineer for our Electrical Products and Services (EPS) team. EPS is a global engineering team within AWS Data Center Engineering, responsible for the design, development, and continuous improvement of electrical power distribution products used across our rapidly expanding data center footprint. Our product portfolio spans the full electrical distribution chain, including medium voltage switchgear, medium voltage transformers, low voltage switchgear, generators, busduct, transfer switches, power distribution cabinets, and other critical electrical infrastructure.  
  
The EPS team works to design and develop resilient, cost-effective electrical distribution products and systems. As an engineer at Amazon, they are responsible for achieving world class uptime for our customers. They drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs and communicate technical direction to senior leadership. They seek new ways to improve the reliability, scalability, and cost effectiveness of our engineering designs. As a product engineer at Amazon, they will work with other internal groups as well as external groups including engineering service providers, manufacturers, vendors, inspectors, third party testing labs, and contractors.

Chartis Federal is a premier systems engineering and integration firm specializing in mission-critical IT and communications solutions for law enforcement, homeland security, and defense. Our commitment to excellence has fueled our year-over-year growth, earning us recognition twice as a Washington Technology FAST 50 company and securing a place on the Inc. 5000 list for five consecutive years. At Chartis Federal, our mission is clear: keeping heroes safe and connected—on the battlefield, on the border, and in our backyards.

**Position Overview**

Chartis is seeking a Senior Communications Systems Engineer, able to obtain a Public Trust clearance, to provide Systems Engineering Technical Assistance (SETA) support to our customer’s Disaster Emergency Communications Division (DECD). This role works on high-visibility, mission-critical aspects of the program, evaluating, designing, and documenting the fixed, mobile, and tactical communications systems that support federal disaster response. This position will be hybrid (onsite 2 days a week, with potential to be fully onsite).

**Responsibilities**

* Continuously evaluate technological advancements in Federal, State, Local, Tribal, and Territorial (FSLTT) communications equipment capabilities and anticipated requirements.
* Provide Systems Engineering Technical Assistance (SETA) to update the Tactical End-State Architecture (TESA) and develop strategic initiatives for the continued refresh and life-cycle management of communications technology supporting response missions.
* Assess how existing capabilities can meet FSLTT communications requirements, drawing on State Emergency Communications Annexes and Regional Emergency Communications Plans (RECPs).
* Evaluate 5-year anticipated technology trends to update technology roadmaps and communications strategic plans, and recommend improvements to FEMA’s capabilities in support of its disaster response mission.
* Provide expert-level technical, engineering, and CAD/GIS support to conduct baseline analysis, documentation, and engineering diagrams and schematics for fixed, mobile, and tactical communications assets.
* Support communications systems including satellite, radio frequency (RF), LTE, broadband, Next Generation 911 (NG911), and the development of FirstNet systems, and evaluate emerging technologies such as 5G, high-throughput satellite (HTS), and low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite.
* Perform RF propagation analysis and modeling, site surveys, and technical evaluation of emerging technologies.
* Evaluate program adherence to federal and agency policies and regulations.
* Develop executive-level reports and briefings on technology trends and their implications for disaster emergency communications.

* Master’s degree (MA/MS) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a closely related field; more than 10 years of progressively relevant communications engineering experience.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer - Payload Integrations
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Payload Integrations team owns everything that connects to the vehicle beyond the base platform. This includes gimbals and EO/IR sensors, arming and fuzing devices, weapons payloads, radios, and other mission hardware. We build the software and interfaces that enable these payloads to reliably run on the vehicle. Nearly every customer program needs a new or modified payload, which makes this team a critical contributor to nearly everything we ship. Our work goes from the lab bench to hardware-in-the-loop testing to live flight, and it has to work in a variety of demanding operational environments.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Payload Integrations team. You will design, build, and maintain the software that brings new sensors, communications systems, and mission payloads onto our autonomous vehicles. You will work closely with hardware, electrical, autonomy, and systems engineering teams, as well as outside payload vendors, to turn new hardware into dependable, well-tested components of the vehicle. If you are self-motivated, hold yourself to high standards, enjoy working where software meets hardware, and do well in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment, this role is for you.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Design and implement software integrations for gimbals, EO/IR sensors, radios, arming and fuzing devices, and other mission payloads on autonomous vehicles.
* Define and maintain clean, reusable interfaces between payloads and the vehicle software stack, to enable new payloads without changes to autonomy code.
* Work through vendor interface control documents (ICDs), implement device drivers and protocol handlers, and lead hardware bring-up in the lab.
* Build simulation, emulation, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test infrastructure to evaluate payload behavior before flight.
* Support integration events, ground tests, and flight tests, and root-cause issues across software, firmware, and hardware boundaries.
* Partner with program teams to scope, estimate, and deliver payload integrations for customer projects on tight timelines.
* Contribute to the safety-critical software behind arming and weapons-related payloads, with a high bar for rigor, review, and testing.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on embedded systems, robotics, or hardware integration.
* Strong experience with Rust and/or C++, plus working proficiency in Python.
* Hands-on experience integrating hardware over common interfaces and protocols (e.g., UART/RS-422, CAN, Ethernet/UDP, SPI/I2C).
* Experience reading datasheets and ICDs and turning them into robust software implementations.
* Comfort debugging at the hardware/software boundary using lab equipment and bus/packet analysis.
* Experience developing on Linux-based systems.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, including working with external vendors and cross-functional engineering teams.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer - Realtime Pipeline
new_jobs.description:
**About Bridge Neurotech**
--------------------------

Bridge Neurotech is building a non-invasive functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) platform with AI-based neural decoding for brain-computer interface applications. We are a seed-stage neurotechnology company developing technology that has the potential to transform how we interact with the human brain.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a Software Engineer - Realtime Pipeline to own the realtime system that runs from raw RF data off the probe all the way to decoded outputs from our neural decoding model — beamforming, imaging preprocessing, and ML inference, all in one tightly coupled latency budget. The inference latency budget is tightly coupled to the imaging pipeline latency budget: they share GPU, share memory, share the data stream. This role owns the entire realtime path and is accountable for it as one system.

Given the neural decoding model, you turn it into a production realtime decoder, sitting on top of the imaging pipeline you have also built. We build from open primitives like the Mach beamformer (https://github.com/Forest-Neurotech/mach), and you provide the technical leadership and strategy to mature the system — designing, developing, testing, deploying, and enhancing it into a scalable software solution — including what to extend, what to replace, and what to push upstream.

You will work closely with our ML/AI Lead on the model serving boundary, our Embedded Systems Engineer on the data handoff from the probe, our Imaging Scientist on the imaging pipeline itself, and our Applications Engineer on the decoded output handoff downstream.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own the end-to-end realtime path: raw RF data ingestion, beamforming, processing (e.g., clutter filtering), ML preprocessing, model inference, and decoded output.
* Build the ML inference engine: model loading from artifacts, GPU memory residency, batching, TensorRT/ONNX or hand-built CUDA inference, and kernel-level integration with the upstream imaging compute.
* Integrate, extend, and, where appropriate, contribute to GPU beamforming.
* Hit and hold realtime throughput and latency targets at multi-Gbit/s ingest with deterministic tail latency suitable for closed-loop decoding.
* Define and own the model serving contract with the ML/AI Lead and the path for model updates without service interruption.
* Build the streaming and storage layer that serves raw and processed data to both offline training and realtime inference.
* Collaborate with other team members to define the upstream interface to the device acquisition layer and the downstream interface to the BCI applications layer.
* Build observability into every stage and develop benchmarks and regression tests that lock in both pipeline performance and inference correctness as the system evolves.

**Who You Are**
---------------

**Required**

* BS/MS/PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field, with 8+ years building production realtime or HPC systems.
* Expert-level CUDA and modern C++; experience writing or extensively modifying GPU kernels for signal processing or imaging workloads.
* Demonstrated experience building production ML inference systems: taking trained PyTorch (or equivalent) models to deployment on GPUs under hard latency budgets. Hands-on with TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, Triton, or hand-built CUDA inference engines.
* Demonstrated experience building realtime data pipelines at multi-Gbit/s rates with tight latency budgets.
* Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and the signal processing stack relevant to imaging or RF: beamforming concepts, FFTs, IQ demodulation, SVD-based filtering, autocorrelation.
* Proficiency in Python and the PyTorch ecosystem sufficient to collaborate with the ML team, identify what needs to change for production, and have informed conversations about model architecture trade-offs that affect latency.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with functional imaging or other high-data-rate imaging modalities.
* Experience integrating ML inference with upstream realtime compute, including shared GPU memory layouts and minimizing host–device round-trips.
* Experience with high-bandwidth I/O: GPUDirect Storage, RDMA, kernel-bypass networking, NVMe arrays.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* The opportunity to shape a role and a team from the earliest stages.
* Direct collaboration with leading clinicians and neuroscientists at top-tier academic institutions.
* Excellent medical benefits and a 401(k) with 6% match.

Bridge Neurotech is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

new_jobs.title: Senior Hardware Engineer, Digital
new_jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team:**

The Avionics team is responsible for the full lifecycle of Terran R's nervous system, designing, building, testing, installing, and operating the hardware that connects and controls every major electrical system on the vehicle and ground. The team leverages close partnership between avionics design, manufacturing, and test to enable rapid iteration and feedback loops. Engineers are deeply embedded into other functions within Relativity, working closely with propulsion, GNC, fluids, and stage engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and operation. Now is a unique time to join: you'll get to help shape Terran R's fundamental avionics architecture and be given a high degree of ownership on components that will fly.

**About the Role:**

As a Digital Hardware Engineer on the Avionics team, you will design, test, and analyze custom high-speed electronics on the Terran R launch vehicle. You will oversee hardware development through the entire product lifecycle from concept to flight maturity to include initial design, board bring-up, design verification, qualification, initial flight production, integration, and vehicle operations. You will work with cross-functional partner teams across the company to help the team make the best possible decisions for the overall vehicle. A strong candidate for the role will have a deep technical background in electronics design and sound project management skills to ensure the hardware project is both reliable and on-schedule to support Terran R's launch!

**About You:**

* Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* 5+ years of experience in electronics designed for harsh environments and mission-critical applications such as launch vehicles, spacecraft, aircraft, or robotics
* Technical expertise in high speed serial interfaces (SPI, PCIe, Ethernet, etc.); memory interfaces; design for SoCs, microcontrollers, and microprocessors
* Experience with eCAD software such as Altium or equivalent
* Experience with hardware bring-up, validation, debugging, and data analysis
* Experience with board-level design from concept to manufacturing
* Experience working with highly cross-functional teams (mechanical, thermal, electrical, software, etc.) to develop integrated electronics solutions

**Nice to haves but not required:**

* Familiarity with embedded software development and integration for avionics systems
* Experience with design for reliability and manufacturability of avionics hardware and systems

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

==================

* Design and implement security enhancements across complex software architectures to improve system integrity, resilience, and secure operation.

* Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or Rust

* Experience with embedded Linux platforms and bootloader frameworks (e.g., Yocto, Buildroot, WolfBoot, U-Boot).

**Who we are**

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

**What we are looking for**

We’re searching for a **Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure** to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Behavior Analysis builds the systems that make that call: the evals that compare model versions, the embedding search that makes every driving scenario findable, and the introspection tools that show why a model did what it did. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes.

**In this role you will**

* Build and scale evaluation pipelines that compare model versions on large driving datasets: offline evals, slice-based metrics, regression detection, and model-vs-model reports.
* Own embedding and vector-search pipelines over driving data, versioned per model, so engineers can search, cluster and compare how any model represents the world. This is where you’d start: owning embedding generation and search end to end.
* Build model introspection infrastructure (attention, attribution, ablations) that turns “why did the model do that?” from a research project into a query.
* Help define how frontier LLMs, VLMs and agents change ML analysis here: triaging, labeling, clustering and summarizing driving scenarios and eval results. We already have a prototype using LLMs for data curation, and you’d help decide where it goes next.
* Work side by side with the ML engineers training these models to decide what to measure, then make those measurements trustworthy, observable and cheap enough to run on every candidate model.
* Build the web app and CLI that engineers and AI agents use to find datasets, training runs, evals and their costs, designed with agents as first-class users.

**Required qualifications**

* Typically 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, data or ML infrastructure.
* Strong Python, and proficiency with SQL.
* Designed and operated large-scale batch or data pipelines on cloud infrastructure, including backfills, retries and cost management.
* Built systems that measure or evaluate something: metrics, experimentation, evaluation or analytics platforms.
* Experience with distributed compute and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS Batch or similar).

**Desirable qualifications**

* ML evaluation infrastructure: eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression detection, A/B model comparison.
* Embeddings and vector search, or model introspection and interpretability tooling.
* Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation.
* Autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large-scale sensor data.
* Observability for data systems (metrics, alerting, SLOs), and everyday use of AI coding agents.
* Coming from backend or data engineering and want to learn ML evaluation? Apply anyway: we’ll teach you the ML side.

Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits.

At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks.

We believe in-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs.

Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom.
